name: MinSpec.liftOver_comp
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem liftOver_comp {s t r : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (v : t ⟶ r) {x y z : O} (hx : p.obj x = s)
    (hy : p.obj y = t) (hz : p.obj z = r) :
    m.liftOver u hx hy ≫ m.liftOver v hy hz = m.liftOver (u ≫ v) hx hz

name: MinSpec.eqToHom_comp_liftOver
statement:
@[simp] theorem eqToHom_comp_liftOver {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) {x' x y : O} (h : x' = x)
    (hx : p.obj x = s) (hy : p.obj y = t) :
    eqToHom h ≫ m.liftOver u hx hy = m.liftOver u ((congrArg p.obj h).trans hx) hy

name: MinSpec.liftOver_comp_eqToHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftOver_comp_eqToHom {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) {x y y' : O} (h : y = y')
    (hx : p.obj x = s) (hy : p.obj y = t) :
    m.liftOver u hx hy ≫ eqToHom h = m.liftOver u hx ((congrArg p.obj h).symm.trans hy)

name: MinSpec.liftOver_congr
statement:
theorem liftOver_congr {s t s' t' : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (hs : s = s') (ht : t = t') {x y : O}
    (hx : p.obj x = s) (hy : p.obj y = t) :
    m.liftOver u hx hy
      = m.liftOver (eqToHom hs.symm ≫ u ≫ eqToHom ht) (hx.trans hs) (hy.trans ht)

name: MinSpec.inv_liftOver
statement:
@[simp] theorem inv_liftOver {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) [IsIso u] {x y : O} (hx : p.obj x = s)
    (hy : p.obj y = t) : inv (m.liftOver u hx hy) = m.liftOver (inv u) hy hx

name: MinSpec.liftOverIso_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftOverIso_hom {s t : S} (u : s ≅ t) {x y : O} (hx : p.obj x = s)
    (hy : p.obj y = t) : (m.liftOverIso u hx hy).hom = m.liftOver u.hom hx hy

name: MinSpec.liftOverIso_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftOverIso_inv {s t : S} (u : s ≅ t) {x y : O} (hx : p.obj x = s)
    (hy : p.obj y = t) : (m.liftOverIso u hx hy).inv = m.liftOver u.inv hy hx

name: MinSpec.actFunctor_obj
statement: @[simp] theorem actFunctor_obj (g : G) (x : O) : (m.actFunctor g).obj x = m.act x g

name: MinSpec.actFunctor_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem actFunctor_map (g : G) {x y : O} (f : x ⟶ y) :
    (m.actFunctor g).map f = m.liftOver (p.map f) (m.p_act x g) (m.p_act y g)

name: MinSpec.actFunctor_comp_p
statement: theorem actFunctor_comp_p (g : G) : m.actFunctor g ⋙ p = p
proof:
:= by
  fapply CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
  · intro x; exact m.p_act x g
  · intro x y f; exact m.p_map_liftOver (p.map f) (m.p_act x g) (m.p_act y g)

name: MinSpec.p_map_actFunctor_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem p_map_actFunctor_map (g : G) {x y : O} (f : x ⟶ y) :
    p.map ((m.actFunctor g).map f)
      = eqToHom (m.p_act x g) ≫ p.map f ≫ eqToHom (m.p_act y g).symm
proof:
:=
  m.p_map_liftOver (p.map f) (m.p_act x g) (m.p_act y g)

name: MinSpec.actFunctor_one
statement: theorem actFunctor_one : m.actFunctor 1 = 𝟭 O
proof:
:= by
  fapply CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
  · intro x; exact m.act_one x
  · intro x y f
    have key : m.liftOver (p.map f) (m.p_act x 1) (m.p_act y 1)
        = eqToHom (m.act_one x) ≫ f ≫ eqToHom (m.act_one y).symm := by
      apply m.hom_ext
      simp [eqToHom_map]
    exact key

name: MinSpec.actFunctor_mul
statement: theorem actFunctor_mul (g h : G) : m.actFunctor g ⋙ m.actFunctor h = m.actFunctor (g * h)
proof:
:= by
  fapply CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
  · intro x; exact m.act_mul x g h
  · intro x y f
    have key : m.liftOver (p.map (m.liftOver (p.map f) (m.p_act x g) (m.p_act y g)))
          (m.p_act (m.act x g) h) (m.p_act (m.act y g) h)
        = eqToHom (m.act_mul x g h) ≫ m.liftOver (p.map f) (m.p_act x (g * h))
            (m.p_act y (g * h)) ≫ eqToHom (m.act_mul y g h).symm := by
      apply m.hom_ext
      simp
    exact key

name: OEData.toMinSpec_e_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem toMinSpec_e_apply (x : O) : d.toMinSpec.e x = (p.obj x, d.coord x)

name: OEData.toMinSpec_e_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem toMinSpec_e_symm_apply (sg : S × G) :
    d.toMinSpec.e.symm sg = d.act (d.base sg.1) sg.2

name: OEData.toMinSpec_coord
statement: @[simp] theorem toMinSpec_coord (x : O) : d.toMinSpec.coord x = d.coord x

name: OEData.toMinSpec_base
statement: @[simp] theorem toMinSpec_base (s : S) : d.toMinSpec.base s = d.base s

name: OEData.toMinSpec_act
statement: @[simp] theorem toMinSpec_act (x : O) (g : G) : d.toMinSpec.act x g = d.act x g
proof:
:= by
  change d.act (d.base (p.obj x)) (d.coord x * g) = d.act x g
  rw [← d.act_mul, d.base_coord]

name: OEData.toMinSpec_actFunctor
statement: theorem toMinSpec_actFunctor (g : G) : d.toMinSpec.actFunctor g = d.actFunctor g
proof:
:= by
  fapply CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
  · intro x; exact d.toMinSpec_act x g
  · intro x y f
    have key : d.toMinSpec.liftOver (p.map f) (d.toMinSpec.p_act x g) (d.toMinSpec.p_act y g)
        = eqToHom (d.toMinSpec_act x g) ≫ d.actHom f g ≫ eqToHom (d.toMinSpec_act y g).symm := by
      apply d.toMinSpec.hom_ext
      simp [eqToHom_map, d.p_actHom]
    exact key

name: Components.eq_of_zigzag_of_hom
statement:
theorem eq_of_zigzag_of_hom {α : Sort*} (f : S → α) (hf : ∀ {s t : S} (_ : s ⟶ t), f s = f t)
    {a b : S} (h : Zigzag a b) : f a = f b
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ hz ih =>
    refine ih.trans ?_
    rcases hz with ⟨⟨u⟩⟩ | ⟨⟨u⟩⟩
    · exact hf u
    · exact (hf u).symm

name: Components.liftComp_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftComp_mk {α : Sort*} (f : S → α) (hf : ∀ {s t : S} (_ : s ⟶ t), f s = f t)
    (s : S) : liftComp f hf (compMk s) = f s

name: Components.componentMap_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentMap_mk (A : S ⥤ S) (s : S) :
    componentMap A (compMk s) = compMk (A.obj s)

name: Components.componentMap_comp
statement:
theorem componentMap_comp (A B : S ⥤ S) (c : CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S) :
    componentMap (A ⋙ B) c = componentMap B (componentMap A c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c using Quotient.ind; rfl

name: Components.componentMap_id
statement:
theorem componentMap_id (c : CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S) :
    componentMap (𝟭 S) c = c
proof:
:= by
  induction c using Quotient.ind; rfl

name: componentAction_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentAction_apply (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S)) (A : H)
    (γ : CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S → G) (c : CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S) :
    componentAction H G A γ c = γ (componentMap A.1.inv c)

name: componentAction_apply_mk
statement:
theorem componentAction_apply_mk (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S)) (A : H)
    (γ : CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S → G) (s : S) :
    componentAction H G A γ (compMk s) = γ (compMk (A.1.inv.obj s))

name: componentAction_apply_eq_perm
statement:
theorem componentAction_apply_eq_perm (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S)) (A : H)
    (γ : CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S → G) :
    componentAction H G A γ = γ ∘ (componentPerm A.1).symm

name: componentAction_apply_perm_inv
statement:
theorem componentAction_apply_perm_inv (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S)) (A : H)
    (γ : CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S → G) (c : CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S) :
    componentAction H G A γ c = γ (componentPerm A.1⁻¹ c)

name: componentPerm_inv
statement: theorem componentPerm_inv (A : StrictAut S) : componentPerm A⁻¹ = (componentPerm A)⁻¹

name: objectAction_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem objectAction_apply (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S)) (A : H) (γ : S → G) (s : S) :
    objectAction H G A γ s = γ (A.1.inv.obj s)

name: Components.liftByMultiplier_comp
statement:
theorem liftByMultiplier_comp (d : OEData G p) (A B : S ⥤ S) (k l : S → G) :
    liftByMultiplier d A k ⋙ liftByMultiplier d B l
      = liftByMultiplier d (A ⋙ B) (fun s => l (A.obj s) * k s)
proof:
:= by
  refine lift_eq_of_obj_eq d ?_ (liftByMultiplier_covers d _ _) (fun x => ?_)
  · rw [Functor.assoc, liftByMultiplier_covers, ← Functor.assoc, liftByMultiplier_covers,
      Functor.assoc]
  · show d.act (d.base (B.obj (p.obj (d.act (d.base (A.obj (p.obj x))) (k (p.obj x) * d.coord x)))))
        (l (p.obj (d.act (d.base (A.obj (p.obj x))) (k (p.obj x) * d.coord x)))
          * d.coord (d.act (d.base (A.obj (p.obj x))) (k (p.obj x) * d.coord x)))
      = d.act (d.base (B.obj (A.obj (p.obj x)))) (l (A.obj (p.obj x)) * k (p.obj x) * d.coord x)
    rw [d.p_act, d.p_base, d.coord_base, mul_assoc]

name: Components.liftByMultiplier_eq_liftFunctor_comp_ΛFun
statement:
theorem liftByMultiplier_eq_liftFunctor_comp_ΛFun (d : OEData G p) (A : S ⥤ S) (γ : S → G) :
    liftByMultiplier d A (fun s => γ (A.obj s)) = liftFunctor d A ⋙ ΛFun d γ
proof:
:= by
  refine lift_eq_of_obj_eq d (liftByMultiplier_covers d _ _) ?_ (fun x => ?_)
  · rw [Functor.assoc, ΛFun_comp_p]; exact (lift_preservesCleavage d A).covers
  · show d.act (d.base (A.obj (p.obj x))) (γ (A.obj (p.obj x)) * d.coord x)
      = d.act (d.base (p.obj (d.act (d.base (A.obj (p.obj x))) (d.coord x))))
          (γ (p.obj (d.act (d.base (A.obj (p.obj x))) (d.coord x)))
            * d.coord (d.act (d.base (A.obj (p.obj x))) (d.coord x)))
    rw [d.p_act, d.p_base, d.coord_base]

name: Components.liftFunctor_conj_ΛFun
statement:
theorem liftFunctor_conj_ΛFun (d : OEData G p) (A : StrictAut S) (γ : S → G) :
    liftFunctor d A.inv ⋙ ΛFun d γ ⋙ liftFunctor d A.hom
      = ΛFun d (fun s => γ (A.inv.obj s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Functor.assoc, ← liftByMultiplier_eq_liftFunctor_comp_ΛFun, ← liftByMultiplier_one d A.hom,
    liftByMultiplier_comp, A.inv_hom_id]
  have h := liftByMultiplier_eq_liftFunctor_comp_ΛFun d (𝟭 S) (fun s => γ (A.inv.obj s))
  rw [lift_id, Functor.id_comp] at h
  rw [← h]
  congr 1
  funext s
  exact one_mul _

name: Components.autBoxGOver_ext
statement:
theorem autBoxGOver_ext {d : OEData G p} {H : Subgroup (StrictAut S)} {e₁ e₂ : AutBoxGOver d H}
    (h : e₁.1.hom = e₂.1.hom) : e₁ = e₂

name: Components.componentMultiplier_mk
Components.liftMultiplier_factors_through_components
proof:
:=
  ⟨componentMultiplier d pc, fun _ => rfl, fun κ hκ => funext fun c => by
    induction c using Quotient.ind with
    | _ a => exact (hκ a).symm⟩

name: Components.componentLiftMultiplier_hom
statement:
theorem componentLiftMultiplier_hom (A : S ⥤ S) (γ : CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S → G)
    {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) : componentLiftMultiplier A γ s = componentLiftMultiplier A γ t

name: Components.liftByMultiplier_components_eq
statement:
theorem liftByMultiplier_components_eq (d : OEData G p) (A : S ⥤ S)
    (γ : CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S → G) :
    liftByMultiplier d A (componentLiftMultiplier A γ)
      = liftFunctor d A ⋙ ΛFun d (fun s => γ (compMk s))
proof:
:=
  liftByMultiplier_eq_liftFunctor_comp_ΛFun d A (fun s => γ (compMk s))

name: autBoxGOverOfComponents_hom_eq
statement:
theorem autBoxGOverOfComponents_hom_eq (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (x : (CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S → G) ⋊[componentAction H G] H) :
    (autBoxGOverOfComponents d H x).1.hom
      = liftFunctor d x.right.1.hom ⋙ ΛFun d (fun s => x.left (compMk s))

name: liftMultiplier_autBoxGOverOfComponents
statement:
theorem liftMultiplier_autBoxGOverOfComponents (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (x : (CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S → G) ⋊[componentAction H G] H) (s : S) :
    liftMultiplier d (autBoxGOverOfComponents d H x).1.hom s = x.left (compMk (x.right.1.hom.obj s))
proof:
:= by
  show liftMultiplier d (liftByMultiplier d _ _) s = _
  rw [liftMultiplier_liftByMultiplier]; rfl

name: autBoxGOverToComponents_ofComponents
statement:
theorem autBoxGOverToComponents_ofComponents (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (x : (CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S → G) ⋊[componentAction H G] H) :
    autBoxGOverToComponents d H (autBoxGOverOfComponents d H x) = x
proof:
:= by
  refine SemidirectProduct.ext (funext fun c => ?_) rfl
  induction c using Quotient.ind with
  | _ a =>
    show liftMultiplier d (liftByMultiplier d x.right.1.hom (componentLiftMultiplier x.right.1.hom x.left))
        (x.right.1.inv.obj a) = x.left (compMk a)
    rw [liftMultiplier_liftByMultiplier]
    show x.left (compMk (x.right.1.hom.obj (x.right.1.inv.obj a))) = x.left (compMk a)
    rw [show x.right.1.hom.obj (x.right.1.inv.obj a) = a from Functor.congr_obj x.right.1.inv_hom_id a]

name: autBoxGOverOfComponents_toComponents
statement:
theorem autBoxGOverOfComponents_toComponents (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (e : AutBoxGOver d H) :
    autBoxGOverOfComponents d H (autBoxGOverToComponents d H e) = e
proof:
:= by
  refine autBoxGOver_ext ?_
  show liftByMultiplier d e.1.base.hom
      (fun s => liftMultiplier d e.1.hom (e.1.base.inv.obj (e.1.base.hom.obj s))) = e.1.hom
  have h : (fun s => liftMultiplier d e.1.hom (e.1.base.inv.obj (e.1.base.hom.obj s)))
      = liftMultiplier d e.1.hom := funext fun s => by
    rw [show e.1.base.inv.obj (e.1.base.hom.obj s) = s from Functor.congr_obj e.1.base.hom_inv_id s]
  rw [h]
  exact (eq_liftByMultiplier d e.1.equiv e.1.pres.covers).symm

name: autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents_apply (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (e : AutBoxGOver d H) :
    autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents d H e = autBoxGOverToComponents d H e

name: autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents_symm_apply (d : OEData G p)
    (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (x : (CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S → G) ⋊[componentAction H G] H) :
    (autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents d H).symm x = autBoxGOverOfComponents d H x

name: autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents_right
statement:
theorem autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents_right (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (e : AutBoxGOver d H) : (autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents d H e).right = ΦOver d H e

name: autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents_symm_inl_hom
statement:
theorem autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents_symm_inl_hom (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (γ : CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S → G) :
    ((autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents d H).symm (SemidirectProduct.inl γ)).1.hom
      = ΛFun d (fun s => γ (compMk s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents_symm_apply, autBoxGOverOfComponents_hom_eq]
  show liftFunctor d (𝟭 S) ⋙ _ = _
  rw [lift_id, Functor.id_comp]; rfl

name: autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents_symm_inr
statement:
theorem autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents_symm_inr (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (A : H) :
    (autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents d H).symm (SemidirectProduct.inr A) = liftHomOver d H A
proof:
:= by
  refine autBoxGOver_ext ?_
  rw [autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents_symm_apply, autBoxGOverOfComponents_hom_eq]
  show _ ⋙ ΛFun d 1 = liftFunctor d A.1.hom
  rw [ΛFun_one, Functor.comp_id]; rfl

name: autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents_symm_inr_hom
statement:
theorem autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents_symm_inr_hom (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (A : H) :
    ((autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents d H).symm (SemidirectProduct.inr A)).1.hom
      = liftFunctor d A.1.hom

name: liftHomOver_conj_components
statement:
theorem liftHomOver_conj_components (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S)) (A : H)
    (δ : CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S → G) :
    liftHomOver d H A * (autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents d H).symm (SemidirectProduct.inl δ)
        * (liftHomOver d H A)⁻¹
      = (autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents d H).symm
          (SemidirectProduct.inl (componentAction H G A δ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents_symm_inr, ← map_inv, ← map_mul, ← map_mul,
    ← map_inv SemidirectProduct.inr, SemidirectProduct.inl_aut]

name: liftFunctor_conj_ΛFun_components
statement:
theorem liftFunctor_conj_ΛFun_components (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S)) (A : H)
    (δ : CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S → G) :
    liftFunctor d A.1.inv ⋙ ΛFun d (fun s => δ (compMk s)) ⋙ liftFunctor d A.1.hom
      = ΛFun d (fun s => componentAction H G A δ (compMk s))

name: Components.componentFunctions_unique_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem componentFunctions_unique_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty S] :
    Nonempty (Unique (CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S → G))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsEmpty (CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S) :=
    ⟨fun c => Quotient.inductionOn c (fun s => isEmptyElim s)⟩
  exact ⟨Pi.uniqueOfIsEmpty _⟩

name: Components.components_subsingleton
statement:
theorem components_subsingleton [IsPreconnected S] :
    Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.ConnectedComponents S)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun c₁ c₂ => Quotient.inductionOn₂ c₁ c₂ (fun a b => Quotient.sound (isPreconnected_zigzag a b))⟩

name: componentAction_eq_one
statement:
theorem componentAction_eq_one [IsPreconnected S] (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S)) :
    componentAction H G = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI := components_subsingleton (S := S)
  refine MonoidHom.ext fun A => MulEquiv.ext fun γ => funext fun c => ?_
  show γ (componentMap A.1.inv c) = γ c
  rw [Subsingleton.elim (componentMap A.1.inv c) c]

name: AutEquivOver.covers_comp
statement:
theorem covers_comp {F F' : O ⥤ O} {A A' : S ⥤ S} (hc : F ⋙ p = p ⋙ A)
    (hc' : F' ⋙ p = p ⋙ A') : (F ⋙ F') ⋙ p = p ⋙ (A ⋙ A')
proof:
:= by
  rw [Functor.assoc, hc', ← Functor.assoc, hc, Functor.assoc]

name: AutEquivOver.covers_inv
statement:
theorem covers_inv {F Finv : O ⥤ O} {B : StrictAut S} (ih : Finv ⋙ F = 𝟭 O)
    (hc : F ⋙ p = p ⋙ B.hom) : Finv ⋙ p = p ⋙ B.inv
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (Finv ⋙ p) ⋙ B.hom = p := by
    rw [Functor.assoc, ← hc, ← Functor.assoc, ih, Functor.id_comp]
  calc Finv ⋙ p
      = (Finv ⋙ p) ⋙ B.hom ⋙ B.inv := by rw [B.hom_inv_id, Functor.comp_id]
    _ = ((Finv ⋙ p) ⋙ B.hom) ⋙ B.inv := rfl
    _ = p ⋙ B.inv := by rw [h1]

name: AutEquivOver.mul_hom
statement: @[simp] lemma mul_hom (e₁ e₂ : AutEquivOver d H) : (e₁ * e₂).hom = e₂.hom ⋙ e₁.hom

name: AutEquivOver.mul_base
statement: @[simp] lemma mul_base (e₁ e₂ : AutEquivOver d H) : (e₁ * e₂).base = e₁.base * e₂.base

name: AutEquivOver.one_hom
statement: @[simp] lemma one_hom : (1 : AutEquivOver d H).hom = 𝟭 O

name: AutEquivOver.one_base
statement: @[simp] lemma one_base : (1 : AutEquivOver d H).base = 1

name: AutEquivOver.inv_hom
statement: @[simp] lemma inv_hom (e : AutEquivOver d H) : e⁻¹.hom = e.inv

name: AutEquivOver.ext_hom
statement:
theorem ext_hom {e₁ e₂ : AutEquivOver d H} (h : e₁.hom = e₂.hom) (hb : e₁.base = e₂.base) :
    e₁ = e₂
proof:
:= by
  refine AutEquivOver.ext h ?_ hb
  calc e₁.inv = e₁.inv ⋙ (e₂.hom ⋙ e₂.inv) := by rw [e₂.hom_inv_id, Functor.comp_id]
    _ = e₁.inv ⋙ (e₁.hom ⋙ e₂.inv) := by rw [h]
    _ = (e₁.inv ⋙ e₁.hom) ⋙ e₂.inv := rfl
    _ = e₂.inv := by rw [e₁.inv_hom_id, Functor.id_comp]

name: ΦEquivOver_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem ΦEquivOver_apply (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (e : AutEquivOver d H) : ΦEquivOver d H e = e.base

name: autEquivOverOfObject_hom_eq
statement:
theorem autEquivOverOfObject_hom_eq (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (x : (S → G) ⋊[objectAction H G] H) :
    (autEquivOverOfObject d H x).hom = liftFunctor d x.right.1.hom ⋙ ΛFun d x.left

name: autEquivOverToObject_ofObject
statement:
theorem autEquivOverToObject_ofObject (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (x : (S → G) ⋊[objectAction H G] H) :
    autEquivOverToObject d H (autEquivOverOfObject d H x) = x
proof:
:= by
  refine SemidirectProduct.ext (funext fun t => ?_) rfl
  show liftMultiplier d (liftByMultiplier d x.right.1.hom (fun s => x.left (x.right.1.hom.obj s)))
      (x.right.1.inv.obj t) = x.left t
  rw [liftMultiplier_liftByMultiplier]
  show x.left (x.right.1.hom.obj (x.right.1.inv.obj t)) = x.left t
  rw [show x.right.1.hom.obj (x.right.1.inv.obj t) = t from Functor.congr_obj x.right.1.inv_hom_id t]

name: autEquivOverOfObject_toObject
statement:
theorem autEquivOverOfObject_toObject (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (e : AutEquivOver d H) : autEquivOverOfObject d H (autEquivOverToObject d H e) = e
proof:
:= by
  refine AutEquivOver.ext_hom ?_ rfl
  show liftByMultiplier d e.base.1.hom
      (fun s => liftMultiplier d e.hom (e.base.1.inv.obj (e.base.1.hom.obj s))) = e.hom
  have h : (fun s => liftMultiplier d e.hom (e.base.1.inv.obj (e.base.1.hom.obj s)))
      = liftMultiplier d e.hom := funext fun s => by
    rw [show e.base.1.inv.obj (e.base.1.hom.obj s) = s from Functor.congr_obj e.base.1.hom_inv_id s]
  rw [h]
  exact (eq_liftByMultiplier d e.equiv e.covers).symm

name: autEquivOverMulEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem autEquivOverMulEquiv_apply (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (e : AutEquivOver d H) : autEquivOverMulEquiv d H e = autEquivOverToObject d H e

name: autEquivOverMulEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem autEquivOverMulEquiv_symm_apply (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (x : (S → G) ⋊[objectAction H G] H) :
    (autEquivOverMulEquiv d H).symm x = autEquivOverOfObject d H x

name: autEquivOverMulEquiv_right
statement:
theorem autEquivOverMulEquiv_right (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (e : AutEquivOver d H) : (autEquivOverMulEquiv d H e).right = ΦEquivOver d H e

name: kerΦEquivOverMulEquiv_symm_hom
statement:
theorem kerΦEquivOverMulEquiv_symm_hom (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (γ : S → G) : ((kerΦEquivOverMulEquiv d H).symm γ).1.hom = ΛFun d γ
proof:
:= by
  show (autEquivOverOfObject d H (SemidirectProduct.inl γ)).hom = ΛFun d γ
  rw [autEquivOverOfObject_hom_eq]
  show liftFunctor d (𝟭 S) ⋙ _ = _
  rw [lift_id, Functor.id_comp]; rfl

name: autEquivOver_preservesCleavage_iff
statement:
theorem autEquivOver_preservesCleavage_iff (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (e : AutEquivOver d H) :
    PreservesCleavage d e.hom e.base.1.hom ↔
      ∀ {s t : S} (_ : s ⟶ t),
        (autEquivOverMulEquiv d H e).left s = (autEquivOverMulEquiv d H e).left t
proof:
:= by
  rw [preservesCleavage_iff_multiplier d e.equiv e.covers]
  have hAA : ∀ s, e.base.1.inv.obj (e.base.1.hom.obj s) = s :=
    fun s => Functor.congr_obj e.base.1.hom_inv_id s
  constructor
  · intro h s t u
    exact h (e.base.1.inv.map u)
  · intro h s t u
    have h' : liftMultiplier d e.hom (e.base.1.inv.obj (e.base.1.hom.obj s))
        = liftMultiplier d e.hom (e.base.1.inv.obj (e.base.1.hom.obj t)) := h (e.base.1.hom.map u)
    rwa [hAA, hAA] at h'

name: autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver_hom (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (e : AutBoxGOver d H) : (autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver d H e).hom = e.1.hom

name: autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver_injective
statement:
theorem autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver_injective (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S)) :
    Function.Injective (autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver d H)

name: ΦEquivOver_comp_autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver
statement:
theorem ΦEquivOver_comp_autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S)) :
    (ΦEquivOver d H).comp (autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver d H) = ΦOver d H

name: mem_range_autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver_iff
statement:
theorem mem_range_autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver_iff (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S))
    (e : AutEquivOver d H) :
    e ∈ (autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver d H).range ↔ PreservesCleavage d e.hom e.base.1.hom
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e', rfl⟩
    exact e'.1.pres
  · intro pc
    exact ⟨⟨⟨e.hom, e.inv, e.hom_inv_id, e.inv_hom_id, e.base.1, e.equiv, pc⟩, e.base.2⟩, rfl⟩

name: autEquivOverMulEquiv_symm_inr_hom
statement:
theorem autEquivOverMulEquiv_symm_inr_hom (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S)) (A : H) :
    ((autEquivOverMulEquiv d H).symm (SemidirectProduct.inr A)).hom = liftFunctor d A.1.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [autEquivOverMulEquiv_symm_apply, autEquivOverOfObject_hom_eq]
  show _ ⋙ ΛFun d 1 = _
  rw [ΛFun_one, Functor.comp_id]; rfl

name: autEquivOverMulEquiv_symm_inr
statement:
theorem autEquivOverMulEquiv_symm_inr (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S)) (A : H) :
    (autEquivOverMulEquiv d H).symm (SemidirectProduct.inr A)
      = autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver d H (liftHomOver d H A)

name: autEquivOver_conj_object
statement:
theorem autEquivOver_conj_object (d : OEData G p) (H : Subgroup (StrictAut S)) (A : H)
    (δ : S → G) :
    autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver d H (liftHomOver d H A)
        * (autEquivOverMulEquiv d H).symm (SemidirectProduct.inl δ)
        * (autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver d H (liftHomOver d H A))⁻¹
      = (autEquivOverMulEquiv d H).symm (SemidirectProduct.inl (objectAction H G A δ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← autEquivOverMulEquiv_symm_inr, ← map_inv, ← map_mul, ← map_mul,
    ← map_inv SemidirectProduct.inr, SemidirectProduct.inl_aut]

name: ComponentsSwapExample.discSwapFunctor_comp_self
statement:
theorem discSwapFunctor_comp_self :
    discSwapFunctor ⋙ discSwapFunctor = 𝟭 (Discrete (Fin 2))
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun i => by
    show Discrete.mk i.as.rev.rev = i
    rw [Fin.rev_rev]) (fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: ComponentsSwapExample.compMk_zero_ne_one
statement:
theorem compMk_zero_ne_one :
    compMk (Discrete.mk (0 : Fin 2)) ≠ compMk (Discrete.mk (1 : Fin 2))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (liftComp (fun s : Discrete (Fin 2) => s.as)
    (fun u => Discrete.eq_of_hom u)) h
  exact absurd this (by decide)

name: ComponentsSwapExample.componentPerm_discSwapAut_zero
statement:
theorem componentPerm_discSwapAut_zero :
    componentPerm discSwapAut (compMk (Discrete.mk 0)) = compMk (Discrete.mk 1)

name: ComponentsSwapExample.componentPerm_discSwapAut_ne_one
statement: theorem componentPerm_discSwapAut_ne_one : componentPerm discSwapAut ≠ 1
proof:
:= fun h =>
  compMk_zero_ne_one ((congrArg (fun π => π (compMk (Discrete.mk 0))) h).symm.trans
    componentPerm_discSwapAut_zero)

name: ComponentsSwapExample.componentAction_discSwap_indicatorZero_ne
statement:
theorem componentAction_discSwap_indicatorZero_ne {g : G} (hg : g ≠ 1)
    (H : Subgroup (StrictAut (Discrete (Fin 2)))) (hH : discSwapAut ∈ H) :
    componentAction H G ⟨discSwapAut, hH⟩ (indicatorZero g) ≠ indicatorZero g

name: ComponentsSwapExample.componentAction_ne_one
statement:
theorem componentAction_ne_one [Nontrivial G] (H : Subgroup (StrictAut (Discrete (Fin 2))))
    (hH : discSwapAut ∈ H) : componentAction H G ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_ne (1 : G)
  exact componentAction_discSwap_indicatorZero_ne hg H hH
    (DFunLike.congr_fun (DFunLike.congr_fun h ⟨discSwapAut, hH⟩) (indicatorZero g))

name: ComponentsSwapExample.componentAction_zpowers_ne_one
statement:
theorem componentAction_zpowers_ne_one [Nontrivial G] :
    componentAction (Subgroup.zpowers discSwapAut) G ≠ 1

name: ComponentsSwapExample.liftHomOver_discSwap_not_comm
statement:
theorem liftHomOver_discSwap_not_comm {q : O ⥤ Discrete (Fin 2)} (d : OEData G q)
    (H : Subgroup (StrictAut (Discrete (Fin 2)))) (hH : discSwapAut ∈ H) {g : G} (hg : g ≠ 1) :
    liftHomOver d H ⟨discSwapAut, hH⟩
        * (autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents d H).symm (SemidirectProduct.inl (indicatorZero g))
      ≠ (autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents d H).symm (SemidirectProduct.inl (indicatorZero g))
        * liftHomOver d H ⟨discSwapAut, hH⟩
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [← autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents_symm_inr, ← map_mul, ← map_mul] at h
  have h' := congrArg SemidirectProduct.left ((autBoxGOverMulEquivComponents d H).symm.injective h)
  rw [SemidirectProduct.mul_left, SemidirectProduct.mul_left] at h'
  apply componentAction_discSwap_indicatorZero_ne hg H hH
  simpa using h'

name: VerticallyTrivial.obj_eq
statement:
theorem obj_eq {F : O ⥤ C} (hF : VerticallyTrivial p F) (σ : StrictSection p) {x y : O}
    (h : p.obj x = p.obj y) : F.obj x = F.obj y

name: VerticallyTrivial.obj_eq_of_minSpec
statement:

name: verticallyTrivial_iff_two_clauses
statement:
theorem verticallyTrivial_iff_two_clauses (σ : StrictSection p) (F : O ⥤ C) :
    VerticallyTrivial p F ↔
      (∀ {x y : O}, p.obj x = p.obj y → F.obj x = F.obj y) ∧
        (∀ {x y : O} (v : x ⟶ y), IsVertical p v → ∃ h : F.obj x = F.obj y, F.map v = eqToHom h)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hF => ⟨fun h => hF.obj_eq σ h, fun v hv => hF v hv⟩, fun hF => fun v hv => hF.2 v hv⟩

name: verticallyTrivial_comp
statement: theorem verticallyTrivial_comp (p : O ⥤ S) (E : S ⥤ C) : VerticallyTrivial p (p ⋙ E)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y v hv
  obtain ⟨h, e⟩ := hv
  refine ⟨congrArg E.obj h, ?_⟩
  show E.map (p.map v) = eqToHom (congrArg E.obj h)
  rw [e, eqToHom_map]

name: obj_eq_of_factor
statement:
theorem obj_eq_of_factor (E : S ⥤ C) {x y : O} (h : p.obj x = p.obj y) :
    (p ⋙ E).obj x = (p ⋙ E).obj y

name: StrictSection.ηHom_isVertical
statement: theorem ηHom_isVertical (x : O) : IsVertical p (σ.ηHom x)

name: StrictSection.ηHom_naturality
statement:
theorem ηHom_naturality {x y : O} (f : x ⟶ y) :
    σ.B.map (p.map f) ≫ σ.ηHom y = σ.ηHom x ≫ f

name: StrictSection.map_η_hom_app
statement:
theorem map_η_hom_app {F : O ⥤ C} (hF : VerticallyTrivial p F) (x : O) :
    ∃ h : F.obj (σ.B.obj (p.obj x)) = F.obj x, F.map (σ.ηHom x) = eqToHom h

name: StrictSection.factor_eq
statement: theorem factor_eq {F : O ⥤ C} (hF : VerticallyTrivial p F) : p ⋙ (σ.B ⋙ F) = F
proof:
:= by
  choose hobj hmap using σ.map_η_hom_app hF
  fapply CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
  · exact hobj
  · intro x y f
    have e : F.map (σ.B.map (p.map f)) ≫ F.map (σ.ηHom y) = F.map (σ.ηHom x) ≫ F.map f := by
      rw [← F.map_comp, ← F.map_comp, σ.ηHom_naturality f]
    have key : F.map (σ.B.map (p.map f)) = eqToHom (hobj x) ≫ F.map f ≫ eqToHom (hobj y).symm := by
      rw [hmap x, hmap y] at e
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← e, Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id]
    exact key

name: StrictSection.factor_unique
statement: theorem factor_unique {F : O ⥤ C} {E : S ⥤ C} (hE : p ⋙ E = F) : E = σ.B ⋙ F
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hE, ← Functor.assoc, σ.B_comp_p, Functor.id_comp]

name: strictSection_descent
statement:
theorem strictSection_descent (σ : StrictSection p) (F : O ⥤ C) :
    VerticallyTrivial p F ↔ ∃! E : S ⥤ C, p ⋙ E = F
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hF
    exact ⟨σ.B ⋙ F, σ.factor_eq hF, fun E hE => σ.factor_unique hE⟩
  · rintro ⟨E, rfl, -⟩
    exact verticallyTrivial_comp p E

name: strictSection_descent_factor
statement:
theorem strictSection_descent_factor (σ : StrictSection p) (F : O ⥤ C) :
    VerticallyTrivial p F ↔
      (p ⋙ (σ.B ⋙ F) = F ∧ ∀ E : S ⥤ C, p ⋙ E = F → E = σ.B ⋙ F)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hF
    exact ⟨σ.factor_eq hF, fun _ hE => σ.factor_unique hE⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, -⟩
    rw [← h]
    exact verticallyTrivial_comp p _

name: StrictSection.natTrans_app_congr
statement:
theorem natTrans_app_congr {E E' : S ⥤ C} (β : E ⟶ E') {s s' : S} (h : s = s') :
    β.app s = eqToHom (congrArg E.obj h) ≫ β.app s' ≫ eqToHom (congrArg E'.obj h).symm

name: StrictSection.family_app_eq_of_vertical
statement:
theorem family_app_eq_of_vertical {E E' : S ⥤ C} (a : ∀ x : O, E.obj (p.obj x) ⟶ E'.obj (p.obj x))
    (ha : ∀ {x y : O} (f : x ⟶ y), E.map (p.map f) ≫ a y = a x ≫ E'.map (p.map f))
    {y x : O} (v : y ⟶ x) (h : p.obj y = p.obj x) (hv : p.map v = eqToHom h) :
    a x = eqToHom (congrArg E.obj h).symm ≫ a y ≫ eqToHom (congrArg E'.obj h)
proof:
:= by
  have nat := ha v
  rw [hv, eqToHom_map, eqToHom_map] at nat
  rw [← nat, ← Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp]

name: StrictSection.B_comp_p_comp
statement: theorem B_comp_p_comp (E : S ⥤ C) : σ.B ⋙ (p ⋙ E) = E

name: StrictSection.descendNatTrans_app
statement:
theorem descendNatTrans_app {E E' : S ⥤ C} (α : p ⋙ E ⟶ p ⋙ E') (s : S) :
    (σ.descendNatTrans α).app s
      = eqToHom (congrArg E.obj (σ.p_obj_B s)).symm ≫ α.app (σ.B.obj s)
        ≫ eqToHom (congrArg E'.obj (σ.p_obj_B s))

name: StrictSection.natTrans_app_eq
statement:
theorem natTrans_app_eq {E E' : S ⥤ C} (α : p ⋙ E ⟶ p ⋙ E') (x : O) :
    α.app x = eqToHom (congrArg E.obj (σ.p_obj_B (p.obj x))).symm
      ≫ α.app (σ.B.obj (p.obj x)) ≫ eqToHom (congrArg E'.obj (σ.p_obj_B (p.obj x)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, e⟩ := σ.ηHom_isVertical x
  exact family_app_eq_of_vertical (fun x => α.app x) (fun f => α.naturality f) (σ.ηHom x) h e

name: StrictSection.whiskerLeft_descendNatTrans
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_descendNatTrans {E E' : S ⥤ C} (α : p ⋙ E ⟶ p ⋙ E') :
    Functor.whiskerLeft p (σ.descendNatTrans α) = α
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact (σ.descendNatTrans_app α (p.obj x)).trans (σ.natTrans_app_eq α x).symm

name: natTrans_descent
statement:
theorem natTrans_descent (σ : StrictSection p) {E E' : S ⥤ C} (α : p ⋙ E ⟶ p ⋙ E') :
    ∃! β : E ⟶ E', Functor.whiskerLeft p β = α
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨σ.descendNatTrans α, σ.whiskerLeft_descendNatTrans α, fun β hβ => ?_⟩
  ext s
  rw [σ.descendNatTrans_app, ← hβ]
  exact StrictSection.natTrans_app_congr β (σ.p_obj_B s).symm

name: natTrans_descent_of_eq
proof:
:= by
  subst hE hE'
  simpa using natTrans_descent σ α

name: StrictSection.map_η_naturality
statement:
theorem map_η_naturality (F : O ⥤ C) {x y : O} (f : x ⟶ y) :
    F.map (σ.B.map (p.map f)) ≫ F.map (σ.η.hom.app y) = F.map (σ.η.hom.app x) ≫ F.map f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← F.map_comp, ← F.map_comp]
  exact congrArg F.map (σ.η.hom.naturality f)

MinSpec.descendNatTrans_app

name: MinSpec.objectFunction_descent
statement:
theorem objectFunction_descent {X : Sort*} (f : O → X) :
    (∀ x g, f (m.act x g) = f x) ↔ ∃! f' : S → X, f = f' ∘ p.obj
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf
    refine ⟨fun s => f (m.base s), ?_, ?_⟩
    · funext x
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      conv_lhs => rw [← m.base_coord x]
      exact hf _ _
    · intro f' hf'
      funext s
      simp only [hf', Function.comp_apply, m.p_base]
  · rintro ⟨f', rfl, -⟩ x g
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, m.p_act]

name: OEData.natTrans_descent_of_eq

name: OEData.objectFunction_descent
statement:
theorem objectFunction_descent {X : Sort*} (f : O → X) :
    (∀ x g, f (d.act x g) = f x) ↔ ∃! f' : S → X, f = f' ∘ p.obj
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf
    refine ⟨fun s => f (d.base s), ?_, ?_⟩
    · funext x
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      conv_lhs => rw [← d.base_coord x]
      exact hf _ _
    · intro f' hf'
      funext s
      simp only [hf', Function.comp_apply, d.p_base]
  · rintro ⟨f', rfl, -⟩ x g
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, d.p_act]

name: invariantPairFunctor_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem invariantPairFunctor_map (G : Type*) [Group G] {a b : Pair G} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (invariantPairFunctor G).map f = (b.pt * a.pt⁻¹ : G)

name: invariantPairFunctor_invariant
statement:
theorem invariantPairFunctor_invariant (G : Type*) [Group G] (h : G) :
    (witness G).actFunctor h ⋙ invariantPairFunctor G = invariantPairFunctor G
proof:
:= by
  fapply CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
  · intro _; rfl
  · intro a b f
    show _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ _ ≫ 𝟙 _
    rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
    show (b.pt * h) * (a.pt * h)⁻¹ = b.pt * a.pt⁻¹
    group

name: invariantPairFunctor_not_verticallyTrivial
statement:
theorem invariantPairFunctor_not_verticallyTrivial (G : Type*) [Group G] [Nontrivial G] :
    ¬ VerticallyTrivial (pWit G) (invariantPairFunctor G)
proof:
:= by
  intro hF
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_ne (1 : G)
  let v : Pair.mk (1 : G) ⟶ Pair.mk g := PUnit.unit
  have hv : IsVertical (pWit G) v := ⟨rfl, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  obtain ⟨h, e⟩ := hF v hv
  have e' : g * (1 : G)⁻¹ = 1 := e.trans (eqToHom_refl _ h)
  exact hg (by simpa using e')

name: invariantPairFunctor_no_factor
statement:
theorem invariantPairFunctor_no_factor (G : Type*) [Group G] [Nontrivial G] :
    ¬ ∃ E : Pair PUnit ⥤ SingleObj G, pWit G ⋙ E = invariantPairFunctor G
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨E, hE⟩
  exact invariantPairFunctor_not_verticallyTrivial G (hE ▸ verticallyTrivial_comp (pWit G) E)

:= by
  obtain ⟨h₁, e₁⟩ := hv
  obtain ⟨h₂, e₂⟩ := hw
  exact ⟨h₁.trans h₂, by rw [p.map_comp, e₁, e₂, eqToHom_trans]⟩

name: IsVertical.inv

  refine ⟨h.symm, ?_⟩
  rw [p.map_inv]
  exact IsIso.inv_eq_of_hom_inv_id (by rw [e, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl])

    (hφ : p.map φ
      = eqToHom (m.p_e_symm X.1 X.2.pt) ≫ f.1 ≫ eqToHom (m.p_e_symm Y.1 Y.2.pt).symm) :
    φ = m.normalFormFrom.map f
proof:
:=
  (m.eq_liftOver_iff f.1 (m.p_e_symm X.1 X.2.pt) (m.p_e_symm Y.1 Y.2.pt) φ).2 hφ

name: MinSpec.normalFormTo_comp_normalFormFrom
statement: theorem normalFormTo_comp_normalFormFrom : m.normalFormTo ⋙ m.normalFormFrom = 𝟭 O
proof:
:= by
  fapply CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
  · intro x; exact m.e_symm_p_coord x
  · intro x y f
    have key : m.liftOver (p.map f) (m.p_e_symm (p.obj x) (m.coord x))
          (m.p_e_symm (p.obj y) (m.coord y))
        = eqToHom (m.e_symm_p_coord x) ≫ f ≫ eqToHom (m.e_symm_p_coord y).symm := by
      apply m.hom_ext
      simp [eqToHom_map]
    exact key

name: MinSpec.normalFormFrom_comp_normalFormTo
statement:
theorem normalFormFrom_comp_normalFormTo :
    m.normalFormFrom ⋙ m.normalFormTo = 𝟭 (S × Pair G)
proof:
:= by
  have hobj : ∀ X : S × Pair G,
      ((p.obj (m.e.symm (X.1, X.2.pt)), ⟨m.coord (m.e.symm (X.1, X.2.pt))⟩) : S × Pair G) = X := by
    rintro ⟨s, ⟨g⟩⟩; simp
  fapply CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
  · exact hobj
  · intro X Y f
    have key : ((p.map (m.liftOver f.1 (m.p_e_symm X.1 X.2.pt) (m.p_e_symm Y.1 Y.2.pt)), ⟨⟩) :
          ((p.obj (m.e.symm (X.1, X.2.pt)), ⟨m.coord (m.e.symm (X.1, X.2.pt))⟩) : S × Pair G) ⟶
          (p.obj (m.e.symm (Y.1, Y.2.pt)), ⟨m.coord (m.e.symm (Y.1, Y.2.pt))⟩))
        = eqToHom (hobj X) ≫ f ≫ eqToHom (hobj Y).symm := by
      apply prodPairHom_ext
      simp only [prod_comp_fst, eqToHom_prod_fst, p_map_liftOver]
    exact key

name: MinSpec.normalForm_equivariant
statement:
theorem normalForm_equivariant (g : G) :
    m.actFunctor g ⋙ m.normalFormTo = m.normalFormTo ⋙ normalFormProductAction g
proof:
:= by
  have hobj : ∀ x : O,
      ((p.obj (m.act x g), ⟨m.coord (m.act x g)⟩) : S × Pair G) = (p.obj x, ⟨m.coord x * g⟩) :=
    fun x => by simp
  fapply CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
  · exact hobj
  · intro x y f
    have key : ((p.map (m.liftOver (p.map f) (m.p_act x g) (m.p_act y g)), ⟨⟩) :
          ((p.obj (m.act x g), ⟨m.coord (m.act x g)⟩) : S × Pair G) ⟶
            (p.obj (m.act y g), ⟨m.coord (m.act y g)⟩))
        = eqToHom (hobj x) ≫
          ((p.map f, ⟨⟩) : ((p.obj x, ⟨m.coord x * g⟩) : S × Pair G) ⟶
            (p.obj y, ⟨m.coord y * g⟩)) ≫ eqToHom (hobj y).symm := by
      apply prodPairHom_ext
      simp only [prod_comp_fst, eqToHom_prod_fst, p_map_liftOver]
    exact key

name: MinSpec.normalFormFrom_equivariant
statement:
theorem normalFormFrom_equivariant (g : G) :
    normalFormProductAction g ⋙ m.normalFormFrom = m.normalFormFrom ⋙ m.actFunctor g
proof:
:= by
  fapply CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
  · intro X; exact (m.act_e_symm X.1 X.2.pt g).symm
  · intro X Y f
    have key : m.liftOver f.1 (m.p_e_symm X.1 (X.2.pt * g)) (m.p_e_symm Y.1 (Y.2.pt * g))
        = eqToHom (m.act_e_symm X.1 X.2.pt g).symm
          ≫ m.liftOver (p.map (m.liftOver f.1 (m.p_e_symm X.1 X.2.pt) (m.p_e_symm Y.1 Y.2.pt)))
              (m.p_act _ g) (m.p_act _ g)
          ≫ eqToHom (m.act_e_symm Y.1 Y.2.pt g) := by
      apply m.hom_ext
      simp
    exact key

name: MinSpec.no_strict_retraction
statement:
theorem no_strict_retraction (m : MinSpec G p) [Nontrivial G] [Nonempty S] :
    ¬ ∃ B' : S ⥤ O, p ⋙ B' = 𝟭 O
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨B', hB'⟩
  obtain ⟨s⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty S)
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_ne (1 : G)
  have h1 : B'.obj (p.obj (m.base s)) = m.base s := Functor.congr_obj hB' (m.base s)
  have h2 : B'.obj (p.obj (m.act (m.base s) g)) = m.act (m.base s) g :=
    Functor.congr_obj hB' (m.act (m.base s) g)
  have hp : p.obj (m.act (m.base s) g) = p.obj (m.base s) := m.p_act _ _
  rw [hp, h1] at h2
  have := congrArg m.coord h2
  simp at this
  exact hg this.symm

name: MinSpec.base_hom_isIso
statement:
theorem base_hom_isIso (m : MinSpec G p) (hO : ∀ {x y : O} (f : x ⟶ y), IsIso f)
    {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) :
    IsIso u
proof:
:= by
  have hf := m.p_map_liftOver u (m.p_base s) (m.p_base t)
  haveI : IsIso (m.liftOver u (m.p_base s) (m.p_base t)) := hO _
  have hu : u = eqToHom (m.p_base s).symm ≫ p.map (m.liftOver u (m.p_base s) (m.p_base t))
      ≫ eqToHom (m.p_base t) := by
    rw [hf]; simp
  rw [hu]
  infer_instance

    IsIso f
proof:
:= by
  haveI := m.full
  haveI := m.faithful
  haveI : IsIso (p.map f) := hS _
  exact isIso_of_reflects_iso f p

    (hφ : p.map φ
      = eqToHom ((d.p_act (d.base X.1) X.2.pt).trans (d.p_base X.1)) ≫ f.1 ≫ eqToHom ((d.p_act (d.base Y.1) Y.2.pt).trans (d.p_base Y.1)).symm) :
    φ = (normalFormFrom d).map f
proof:
:=
  (d.toMinSpec.eq_liftOver_iff f.1 ((d.p_act (d.base X.1) X.2.pt).trans (d.p_base X.1)) ((d.p_act (d.base Y.1) Y.2.pt).trans (d.p_base Y.1)) φ).2 hφ

theorem normalFormTo_map_chi (d : OEData G p) {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O)

    (normalFormTo d).map (d.chi u y hy)
      = eqToHom (normalForm_reind d u y hy)
        ≫ ((u, ⟨⟩) : ((s, ⟨d.coord y⟩) : S × Pair G) ⟶ (t, ⟨d.coord y⟩))
        ≫ eqToHom (Prod.ext hy.symm rfl : ((t, ⟨d.coord y⟩) : S × Pair G) = (normalFormTo d).obj y)
proof:
:= by
  apply prodPairHom_ext
  simp only [normalFormTo_map, prod_comp_fst, eqToHom_prod_fst, d.p_chi]
  rfl

statement:
theorem sectionFunctor_map {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) :
    d.sectionFunctor.map u = d.toMinSpec.liftOver u (d.p_base s) (d.p_base t)

name: OEData.p_map_sectionFunctor_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem p_map_sectionFunctor_map {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) :
    p.map (d.sectionFunctor.map u) = eqToHom (d.p_base s) ≫ u ≫ eqToHom (d.p_base t).symm

name: OEData.sectionFunctor_comp_p
statement: theorem sectionFunctor_comp_p : d.sectionFunctor ⋙ p = 𝟭 S
proof:
:= by
  fapply CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
  · intro s; exact d.p_base s
  · intro s t u; exact d.p_map_sectionFunctor_map u

name: OEData.sectionFunctor_map_unique
statement:
theorem sectionFunctor_map_unique {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (f : d.base s ⟶ d.base t)
    (hf : p.map f = eqToHom (d.p_base s) ≫ u ≫ eqToHom (d.p_base t).symm) :
    f = d.sectionFunctor.map u

name: OEData.sectionFunctor_map_eq_chi
statement:
theorem sectionFunctor_map_eq_chi {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) :
    d.sectionFunctor.map u = eqToHom (d.reind_base u).symm ≫ d.chi u (d.base t) (d.p_base t)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply d.sectionFunctor_map_unique
  simp [d.p_chi, eqToHom_map]

name: OEData.toMinSpec_sectionFunctor
statement: theorem toMinSpec_sectionFunctor : d.toMinSpec.sectionFunctor = d.sectionFunctor
proof:
:= by
  fapply CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
  · intro s; exact d.toMinSpec_base s
  · intro s t u
    have key : d.toMinSpec.liftOver u (d.toMinSpec.p_base s) (d.toMinSpec.p_base t)
        = eqToHom (d.toMinSpec_base s) ≫ d.toMinSpec.liftOver u (d.p_base s) (d.p_base t)
          ≫ eqToHom (d.toMinSpec_base t).symm := by
      apply d.toMinSpec.hom_ext
      simp
    exact key

name: OEData.sectionEta_target_eq
statement:
theorem sectionEta_target_eq (x : O) :
    d.act (d.base (p.obj (d.base (p.obj x)))) (d.coord x * d.coord (d.base (p.obj x))) = x
proof:
:= by
  have hc : d.coord (d.base (p.obj x)) = 1 := by
    have := d.coord_base (p.obj x) 1; rwa [d.act_one] at this
  rw [hc, mul_one, d.p_base, d.base_coord]

name: OEData.sectionEta_naturality
statement:
theorem sectionEta_naturality {x y : O} (f : x ⟶ y) :
    d.toMinSpec.liftOver (p.map f) (d.p_base (p.obj x)) (d.p_base (p.obj y))
        ≫ d.ltrans (d.coord y) (d.base (p.obj y)) ≫ eqToHom (d.sectionEta_target_eq y)
      = (d.ltrans (d.coord x) (d.base (p.obj x)) ≫ eqToHom (d.sectionEta_target_eq x)) ≫ f

name: OEData.sectionEta_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem sectionEta_hom_app (x : O) :
    d.sectionEta.hom.app x
      = d.ltrans (d.coord x) (d.base (p.obj x)) ≫ eqToHom (d.sectionEta_target_eq x)

name: OEData.sectionEta_isVertical
statement: theorem sectionEta_isVertical (x : O) : IsVertical p (d.sectionEta.hom.app x)
proof:
:= by
  have key : p.map (d.ltrans (d.coord x) (d.base (p.obj x)) ≫ eqToHom (d.sectionEta_target_eq x))
      = eqToHom (d.p_base (p.obj x)) := by
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, d.p_ltrans, eqToHom_map, eqToHom_trans]
  exact ⟨d.p_base (p.obj x), key⟩

name: OEData.sectionEta_hom_app_eq_liftOver
statement:
theorem sectionEta_hom_app_eq_liftOver (x : O) :
    d.sectionEta.hom.app x = d.toMinSpec.liftOver (𝟙 (p.obj x)) (d.p_base (p.obj x)) rfl
proof:
:= by
  have key : d.ltrans (d.coord x) (d.base (p.obj x)) ≫ eqToHom (d.sectionEta_target_eq x)
      = d.toMinSpec.liftOver (𝟙 (p.obj x)) (d.p_base (p.obj x)) rfl := by
    apply d.toMinSpec.hom_ext
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, d.p_ltrans, eqToHom_map, eqToHom_trans, MinSpec.p_map_liftOver,
      Category.id_comp]
  exact key

name: OEData.strictSection_B
statement: @[simp] theorem strictSection_B : d.strictSection.B = d.sectionFunctor

name: OEData.strictSection_η
statement: @[simp] theorem strictSection_η : d.strictSection.η = d.sectionEta

name: OEData.coord_base_eq_one
statement: theorem coord_base_eq_one (d : OEData G p) (s : S) : d.coord (d.base s) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := d.coord_base s 1
  rwa [d.act_one] at h

name: OEData.coordinate_identities
statement:
theorem coordinate_identities (d : OEData G p) :
    (∀ s, d.coord (d.base s) = 1) ∧
    (∀ x h, d.coord (d.act x h) = d.coord x * h) ∧
    (∀ {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = t),
      d.reind u y hy = d.act (d.base s) (d.coord y) ∧ d.coord (d.reind u y hy) = d.coord y) ∧
    (∀ x a b, d.act x a = d.act x b → a = b)
proof:
:=
  ⟨d.coord_base_eq_one, d.coord_act, fun u y hy => ⟨d.reind_eq u y hy, d.coord_reind u y hy⟩,
    fun x a b hab => by
      have h := congrArg d.coord hab
      rw [d.coord_act, d.coord_act] at h
      exact mul_left_cancel h⟩

name: MinSpec.toOEData_act
statement: @[simp] theorem toOEData_act (x : O) (g : G) : m.toOEData.act x g = m.act x g

name: MinSpec.toOEData_base
statement: @[simp] theorem toOEData_base (s : S) : m.toOEData.base s = m.base s

name: MinSpec.toOEData_coord
statement: @[simp] theorem toOEData_coord (x : O) : m.toOEData.coord x = m.coord x

name: MinSpec.toOEData_reind
statement:
theorem toOEData_reind {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = t) :
    m.toOEData.reind u y hy = m.act (m.base s) (m.coord y)

name: MinSpec.toOEData_actHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem toOEData_actHom {x y : O} (f : x ⟶ y) (g : G) :
    m.toOEData.actHom f g = m.liftOver (p.map f) (m.p_act x g) (m.p_act y g)

name: MinSpec.toOEData_actFunctor
statement: theorem toOEData_actFunctor (g : G) : m.toOEData.actFunctor g = m.actFunctor g

name: MinSpec.toOEData_chi
statement:
@[simp] theorem toOEData_chi {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = t) :
    m.toOEData.chi u y hy = m.liftOver u (m.p_e_symm s (m.coord y)) hy

name: MinSpec.toOEData_ltrans
statement:
@[simp] theorem toOEData_ltrans (a : G) (x : O) :
    m.toOEData.ltrans a x = m.liftOver (𝟙 (p.obj x)) rfl
      ((m.p_act (m.base (p.obj x)) (a * m.coord x)).trans (m.p_base (p.obj x)))

name: MinSpec.toOEData_chi_unique
statement:
theorem toOEData_chi_unique {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = t)
    (f : m.toOEData.reind u y hy ⟶ y)
    (hf : p.map f = eqToHom (m.toOEData.p_reind u y hy) ≫ u ≫ eqToHom hy.symm) :
    f = m.toOEData.chi u y hy
proof:
:=
  (m.eq_liftOver_iff u (m.p_e_symm s (m.coord y)) hy f).2 hf

name: MinSpec.toOEData_ltrans_unique
statement:
theorem toOEData_ltrans_unique (a : G) (x : O)
    (f : x ⟶ m.toOEData.act (m.toOEData.base (p.obj x)) (a * m.toOEData.coord x))
    (hf : p.map f = eqToHom (((m.toOEData.p_act (m.toOEData.base (p.obj x))
        (a * m.toOEData.coord x)).trans (m.toOEData.p_base (p.obj x))).symm)) :
    f = m.toOEData.ltrans a x

name: MinSpec.toOEData_ltrans_inv
statement:
theorem toOEData_ltrans_inv (a : G) (x : O) :
    m.toOEData.ltrans a x
        ≫ m.liftOver (𝟙 (p.obj x))
          ((m.p_act (m.base (p.obj x)) (a * m.coord x)).trans (m.p_base (p.obj x))) rfl
      = 𝟙 x ∧
    m.liftOver (𝟙 (p.obj x))
          ((m.p_act (m.base (p.obj x)) (a * m.coord x)).trans (m.p_base (p.obj x))) rfl
        ≫ m.toOEData.ltrans a x
      = 𝟙 (m.act (m.base (p.obj x)) (a * m.coord x))

name: OEData.ext_of_data
statement:
theorem OEData.ext_of_data (d d' : OEData G p) (hact : d.act = d'.act)
    (hbase : d.base = d'.base) (hcoord : d.coord = d'.coord)
    (hreind : ∀ {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = t),
      d.reind u y hy = d'.reind u y hy) : d = d'
proof:
:= by
  rcases d with ⟨⟨act, act_one, act_mul, p_act, act_free, actHom, actHom_id, actHom_comp,
    actHom_one, actHom_mul, p_actHom, base, p_base, coord, base_coord, coord_base, reind,
    p_reind, chi, p_chi, reind_base, reind_act, chi_act, ltrans, p_ltrans, reind_id, chi_id,
    reind_comp, chi_comp⟩, faithful⟩
  rcases d' with ⟨⟨act', act_one', act_mul', p_act', act_free', actHom', actHom_id',
    actHom_comp', actHom_one', actHom_mul', p_actHom', base', p_base', coord', base_coord',
    coord_base', reind', p_reind', chi', p_chi', reind_base', reind_act', chi_act', ltrans',
    p_ltrans', reind_id', chi_id', reind_comp', chi_comp'⟩, faithful'⟩
  dsimp only at hact hbase hcoord hreind
  subst hact hbase hcoord
  have hr : @reind = @reind' := by
    funext s t u y hy
    exact hreind u y hy
  subst hr
  have hA : @actHom = @actHom' := by
    funext x y f g
    apply faithful.map_injective
    rw [p_actHom, p_actHom']
  subst hA
  have hC : @chi = @chi' := by
    funext s t u y hy
    apply faithful.map_injective
    rw [p_chi, p_chi']
  subst hC
  have hL : @ltrans = @ltrans' := by
    funext a x
    apply faithful.map_injective
    rw [p_ltrans, p_ltrans']
  subst hL
  rfl

name: MinSpec.toOEData_toMinSpec
statement: theorem MinSpec.toOEData_toMinSpec (m : MinSpec G p) : m.toOEData.toMinSpec = m
proof:
:=
  MinSpec.ext (Equiv.ext fun x => by
    rw [OEData.toMinSpec_e_apply, m.e_apply]
    rfl)

name: OEData.toMinSpec_toOEData
statement: theorem OEData.toMinSpec_toOEData (d : OEData G p) : d.toMinSpec.toOEData = d
proof:
:= by
  apply OEData.ext_of_data
  · funext x g
    exact d.toMinSpec_act x g
  · funext s
    exact d.toMinSpec_base s
  · rfl
  · intro s t u y hy
    exact (d.reind_eq u y hy).symm

name: oeDataEquivMinSpec_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem oeDataEquivMinSpec_apply (d : OEData G p) :
    oeDataEquivMinSpec d = d.toMinSpec

name: oeDataEquivMinSpec_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem oeDataEquivMinSpec_symm_apply (m : MinSpec G p) :
    oeDataEquivMinSpec.symm m = m.toOEData

name: OEData.ext_of_coord
statement: theorem OEData.ext_of_coord (d d' : OEData G p) (h : d.coord = d'.coord) : d = d'
proof:
:= by
  apply oeDataEquivMinSpec.injective
  apply MinSpec.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  simp [h]

name: OEData.toMinSpec_full
statement: theorem OEData.toMinSpec_full (d : OEData G p) : d.toMinSpec.full = d.isFull

name: MinSpec.toOEData_isFull
statement: theorem MinSpec.toOEData_isFull (m : MinSpec G p) : m.toOEData.isFull = m.full

name: Calibration.residualAction_intertwines
statement:
theorem residualAction_intertwines (d : OEData G p) {F F' : O ⥤ C}
    (hF : OEData.IsInvariant d F) (hF' : OEData.IsInvariant d F') (α : F ⟶ F')
    (hα : IsInvariantNatTrans d hF hF' α) (s : S) (r : G) :
    (residualAction d F hF s r).hom ≫ α.app (d.base s)
      = α.app (d.base s) ≫ (residualAction d F' hF' s r).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : eqToHom (hF.obj_eq r (d.base s)) ≫ α.app (d.base s)
      = α.app (d.act (d.base s) r) ≫ eqToHom (hF'.obj_eq r (d.base s)) := by
    rw [hα r (d.base s)]
    simp
  have nat : F.map (d.vertArr s r) ≫ α.app (d.act (d.base s) r)
      = α.app (d.base s) ≫ F'.map (d.vertArr s r) :=
    α.naturality (d.vertArr s r)
  rw [residualAction_hom, residualAction_hom, Category.assoc, h1]
  simp only [← Category.assoc, nat]

name: Calibration.basepointFamily_cast
statement:
theorem basepointFamily_cast (d : OEData G p) {F F' : O ⥤ C}
    (β : ∀ s : S, F.obj (d.base s) ⟶ F'.obj (d.base s)) {s t : S} (e : s = t) :
    β s = eqToHom (congrArg (fun u => F.obj (d.base u)) e) ≫ β t
      ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun u => F'.obj (d.base u)) e).symm

name: Calibration.conj_square_aux
statement:
theorem conj_square_aux {P₀ P₁ P₂ P₃ Q₀ Q₁ Q₂ Q₃ : C}
    (a a' : P₀ = P₁) (σ : P₁ ⟶ P₁) (FB : P₁ ⟶ P₂) (b : P₂ = P₃) (b' : P₃ = P₂)
    (βs : P₁ ⟶ Q₁) (βt : P₂ ⟶ Q₂) (c c' : Q₂ = Q₃) (e : Q₁ = Q₀) (e' : Q₀ = Q₁)
    (σ' : Q₁ ⟶ Q₁) (F'B : Q₁ ⟶ Q₂)
    (hB : FB ≫ βt = βs ≫ F'B) (hI : σ ≫ βs = βs ≫ σ') :
    (eqToHom a ≫ σ ≫ FB ≫ eqToHom b) ≫ (eqToHom b' ≫ βt ≫ eqToHom c)
      = (eqToHom a' ≫ βs ≫ eqToHom e) ≫ (eqToHom e' ≫ σ' ≫ F'B ≫ eqToHom c')
proof:
:= by
  subst a b e
  simp [reassoc_of% hB, reassoc_of% hI]

name: Calibration.invariantNatTransOfResidual_app
statement:
theorem invariantNatTransOfResidual_app (d : OEData G p) {F F' : O ⥤ C}
    (hF : OEData.IsInvariant d F) (hF' : OEData.IsInvariant d F')
    (β : ∀ s : S, F.obj (d.base s) ⟶ F'.obj (d.base s)) hnat hint (x : O) :
    (invariantNatTransOfResidual d hF hF' β hnat hint).app x
      = eqToHom (hF.obj_base_eq x).symm ≫ β (p.obj x) ≫ eqToHom (hF'.obj_base_eq x)

name: Calibration.invariantNatTransOfResidual_app_base
statement:
theorem invariantNatTransOfResidual_app_base (d : OEData G p) {F F' : O ⥤ C}
    (hF : OEData.IsInvariant d F) (hF' : OEData.IsInvariant d F')
    (β : ∀ s : S, F.obj (d.base s) ⟶ F'.obj (d.base s)) hnat hint (s : S) :
    (invariantNatTransOfResidual d hF hF' β hnat hint).app (d.base s) = β s
proof:
:= by
  rw [invariantNatTransOfResidual_app, basepointFamily_cast d β (d.p_base s)]
  simp

name: Calibration.isInvariantNatTrans_invariantNatTransOfResidual
statement:
theorem isInvariantNatTrans_invariantNatTransOfResidual (d : OEData G p) {F F' : O ⥤ C}
    (hF : OEData.IsInvariant d F) (hF' : OEData.IsInvariant d F')
    (β : ∀ s : S, F.obj (d.base s) ⟶ F'.obj (d.base s)) hnat hint :
    IsInvariantNatTrans d hF hF' (invariantNatTransOfResidual d hF hF' β hnat hint)
proof:
:= by
  intro h x
  rw [invariantNatTransOfResidual_app, invariantNatTransOfResidual_app,
    basepointFamily_cast d β (d.p_act x h)]
  simp

name: Calibration.existsUnique_invariantNatTrans_iff
statement:
theorem existsUnique_invariantNatTrans_iff (d : OEData G p) {F F' : O ⥤ C}
    (hF : OEData.IsInvariant d F) (hF' : OEData.IsInvariant d F')
    (β : ∀ s : S, F.obj (d.base s) ⟶ F'.obj (d.base s)) :
    (∃! α : F ⟶ F', IsInvariantNatTrans d hF hF' α ∧ ∀ s, α.app (d.base s) = β s)
      ↔ (∀ (s t : S) (u : s ⟶ t),
          F.map (d.sectionFunctor.map u) ≫ β t = β s ≫ F'.map (d.sectionFunctor.map u))
        ∧ ∀ (s : S) (r : G),
          (residualAction d F hF s r).hom ≫ β s = β s ≫ (residualAction d F' hF' s r).hom
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨α, ⟨hα, hβ⟩, -⟩
    refine ⟨fun s t u => ?_, fun s r => ?_⟩
    · rw [← hβ s, ← hβ t]
      exact α.naturality (d.sectionFunctor.map u)
    · rw [← hβ s]
      exact residualAction_intertwines d hF hF' α hα s r
  · rintro ⟨hnat, hint⟩
    refine ⟨invariantNatTransOfResidual d hF hF' β hnat hint,
      ⟨isInvariantNatTrans_invariantNatTransOfResidual d hF hF' β hnat hint,
        invariantNatTransOfResidual_app_base d hF hF' β hnat hint⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro α ⟨hα, hβ⟩
    ext x
    have key : ∀ {X Y : O} (e : X = Y), α.app Y
        = eqToHom (congrArg F.obj e).symm ≫ α.app X ≫ eqToHom (congrArg F'.obj e) := by
      intro X Y e
      subst e
      simp
    rw [invariantNatTransOfResidual_app, ← hβ (p.obj x), key (d.base_coord x),
      hα (d.coord x) (d.base (p.obj x))]
    simp

name: Calibration.action_trivial_iff_of_intertwining
statement:
theorem action_trivial_iff_of_intertwining {X Y : C} (ρ : G →* CategoryTheory.Aut X)
    (ρ' : G →* CategoryTheory.Aut Y) (φ : X ≅ Y)
    (hφ : ∀ r : G, (ρ r).hom ≫ φ.hom = φ.hom ≫ (ρ' r).hom) : ρ = 1 ↔ ρ' = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine MonoidHom.ext fun r => Iso.ext ?_
    have e : φ.hom ≫ (ρ' r).hom = φ.hom ≫ 𝟙 Y := by
      rw [← hφ r, h, Category.comp_id]
      exact Category.id_comp φ.hom
    show (ρ' r).hom = 𝟙 Y
    simpa using congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ Y => φ.inv ≫ k) e
  · intro h
    refine MonoidHom.ext fun r => Iso.ext ?_
    have e : (ρ r).hom ≫ φ.hom = 𝟙 X ≫ φ.hom := by
      rw [hφ r, h, Category.id_comp]
      exact Category.comp_id φ.hom
    show (ρ r).hom = 𝟙 X
    simpa using congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ Y => k ≫ φ.inv) e

name: Calibration.residualAction_trivial_iff_of_invariant_iso
statement:
theorem residualAction_trivial_iff_of_invariant_iso (d : OEData G p) {F F' : O ⥤ C}
    (hF : OEData.IsInvariant d F) (hF' : OEData.IsInvariant d F') (α : F ≅ F')
    (hα : IsInvariantNatTrans d hF hF' α.hom) (s : S) :
    residualAction d F hF s = 1 ↔ residualAction d F' hF' s = 1
proof:
:=
  action_trivial_iff_of_intertwining _ _ (α.app (d.base s))
    (residualAction_intertwines d hF hF' α.hom hα s)

name: residualAction_trivial_of_factors
verticallyTrivial_of_residualAction_trivial
factors_of_residualAction_trivial
residualAction_trivial_of_invariant_iso
statement:
theorem residualAction_trivial_of_invariant_iso (d : OEData G p) {F : O ⥤ C}
    (hF : OEData.IsInvariant d F) {L : S ⥤ C} (α : F ≅ p ⋙ L)
    (hα : IsInvariantNatTrans d hF (isInvariant_comp_p d L) α.hom) (s : S) :
    residualAction d F hF s = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine MonoidHom.ext fun r => Iso.ext ?_
  have hL : (residualAction d (p ⋙ L) (isInvariant_comp_p d L) s r).hom = 𝟙 _ :=
    congrArg (fun φ : G →* CategoryTheory.Aut ((p ⋙ L).obj (d.base s)) => (φ r).hom)
      (residualAction_trivial_of_factors d (isInvariant_comp_p d L) ⟨L, rfl⟩ s)
  have key := Calibration.residualAction_intertwines d hF (isInvariant_comp_p d L) α.hom hα s r
  rw [hL, Category.comp_id] at key
  have key' := congrArg (fun k : F.obj (d.base s) ⟶ (p ⋙ L).obj (d.base s) =>
    k ≫ α.inv.app (d.base s)) key
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app, Category.comp_id] at key'
  exact key'

name: invariant_iso_of_factors
statement:
theorem invariant_iso_of_factors (d : OEData G p) {F : O ⥤ C} (hF : OEData.IsInvariant d F)
    (hE : ∃ E : S ⥤ C, p ⋙ E = F) :
    ∃ (L : S ⥤ C) (α : F ≅ p ⋙ L), IsInvariantNatTrans d hF (isInvariant_comp_p d L) α.hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, rfl⟩ := hE
  exact ⟨E, Iso.refl _, isInvariantNatTrans_id d hF⟩

name: calibration_i_iff_ii
statement:
theorem calibration_i_iff_ii (d : OEData G p) (F : O ⥤ C) (hF : OEData.IsInvariant d F) :
    (∃ (L : S ⥤ C) (α : F ≅ p ⋙ L), IsInvariantNatTrans d hF (isInvariant_comp_p d L) α.hom)
      ↔ ∃ E : S ⥤ C, p ⋙ E = F
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨L, α, hα⟩
    exact factors_of_residualAction_trivial d hF
      (residualAction_trivial_of_invariant_iso d hF α hα)
  · exact invariant_iso_of_factors d hF

name: calibration_ii_iff_iii
statement:
theorem calibration_ii_iff_iii (d : OEData G p) (F : O ⥤ C) (hF : OEData.IsInvariant d F) :
    (∃ E : S ⥤ C, p ⋙ E = F) ↔ ∀ s : S, residualAction d F hF s = 1

name: calibration_i_iff_iii
statement:
theorem calibration_i_iff_iii (d : OEData G p) (F : O ⥤ C) (hF : OEData.IsInvariant d F) :
    (∃ (L : S ⥤ C) (α : F ≅ p ⋙ L), IsInvariantNatTrans d hF (isInvariant_comp_p d L) α.hom)
      ↔ ∀ s : S, residualAction d F hF s = 1
proof:
:=
  (calibration_i_iff_ii d F hF).trans (calibration_ii_iff_iii d F hF)

name: invariant_calibration_tfae
statement:
theorem invariant_calibration_tfae (d : OEData G p) (F : O ⥤ C) (hF : OEData.IsInvariant d F) :
    ((∃ (L : S ⥤ C) (α : F ≅ p ⋙ L), IsInvariantNatTrans d hF (isInvariant_comp_p d L) α.hom)
        ↔ ∃ E : S ⥤ C, p ⋙ E = F) ∧
      ((∃ E : S ⥤ C, p ⋙ E = F) ↔ ∀ s : S, residualAction d F hF s = 1) ∧
      ((∃ (L : S ⥤ C) (α : F ≅ p ⋙ L), IsInvariantNatTrans d hF (isInvariant_comp_p d L) α.hom)
        ↔ ∀ s : S, residualAction d F hF s = 1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨calibration_i_iff_ii d F hF, calibration_ii_iff_iii d F hF, calibration_i_iff_iii d F hF⟩

name: invariant_calibration_list_tfae
statement:
theorem invariant_calibration_list_tfae (d : OEData G p) (F : O ⥤ C)
    (hF : OEData.IsInvariant d F) :
    List.TFAE
      [∃ (L : S ⥤ C) (α : F ≅ p ⋙ L), IsInvariantNatTrans d hF (isInvariant_comp_p d L) α.hom,
        ∃ E : S ⥤ C, p ⋙ E = F,
        ∀ s : S, residualAction d F hF s = 1]
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 ↔ 2 := calibration_i_iff_ii d F hF
  tfae_have 2 ↔ 3 := calibration_ii_iff_iii d F hF
  tfae_finish

name: no_invariant_calibration_of_residualAction_ne_one
proof:
:=
  fun h => hs ((calibration_i_iff_iii d F hF).mp h s)

name: unrestricted_calibration_exists
statement:
theorem unrestricted_calibration_exists (d : OEData G p) (F : O ⥤ C) :
    ∃ L : S ⥤ C, Nonempty (F ≅ p ⋙ L)

name: unrestrictedCalibration_invariant_iff
statement:
theorem unrestrictedCalibration_invariant_iff (d : OEData G p) (F : O ⥤ C)
    (hF : OEData.IsInvariant d F) :
    IsInvariantNatTrans d hF (isInvariant_comp_p d (d.sectionFunctor ⋙ F))
        (unrestrictedCalibration d F).hom
      ↔ ∀ s : S, residualAction d F hF s = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (calibration_i_iff_iii d F hF).mp ⟨_, _, h⟩
  · intro h1
    have hvt : VerticallyTrivial p F := verticallyTrivial_of_residualAction_trivial d hF h1
    have happ : ∀ x : O, ∃ e, (unrestrictedCalibration d F).hom.app x = eqToHom e := by
      intro x
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hvt _ (d.sectionEta_isVertical x)
      have hh : (d.weakDescentIso F).app x = eqToIso e := Iso.ext he
      refine ⟨e.symm, ?_⟩
      show ((d.weakDescentIso F).app x).inv = eqToHom e.symm
      rw [hh]
      rfl
    intro h x
    obtain ⟨e₁, he₁⟩ := happ (d.act x h)
    obtain ⟨e₂, he₂⟩ := happ x
    rw [he₁, he₂]
    simp

name: baseChange_twistFactor_eq_coboundary
statement:
theorem baseChange_twistFactor_eq_coboundary {H : Type*} [Group H] (θ : H →* MulAut G) (c : G)
    (A : H) : c * θ A c⁻¹ = OECocycle.coboundary θ c A

name: liftHomθOver_rebase_conj_ker
statement:
theorem liftHomθOver_rebase_conj_ker :
    ∃ k ∈ (ΦθOver d H θ).ker, ∀ A : H,
      (autBoxGθOverCongr d d' hact hreind H θ).symm (liftHomθOver d' H θ A)
        = k * liftHomθOver d H θ A * k⁻¹
proof:
:=
  ⟨ΛHomθOver d H θ c, ΛHomθOver_base d H θ c, fun A => by
    rw [liftHomθOver_eq_conj_of_base d d' hact hreind hc, MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
      MulAut.conj_apply]⟩

name: liftHomθOver_rebase_semidirect
statement:
theorem liftHomθOver_rebase_semidirect (A : H) :
    autBoxGθOverMulEquivSemidirect d H θ
        ((autBoxGθOverCongr d d' hact hreind H θ).symm (liftHomθOver d' H θ A))
      = OECocycle.cocycleSection (OECocycle.isCocycle_coboundary θ c) A
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftHomθOver_eq_of_base d d' hact hreind hc, MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    MulEquiv.apply_eq_iff_symm_apply]
  show _ = semidirectToAutBoxGθOver d H θ ⟨c * θ A c⁻¹, A⟩
  have h := (semidirectToAutBoxGθOver d H θ).map_mul (SemidirectProduct.inl (c * θ A c⁻¹))
    (SemidirectProduct.inr A)
  rw [semidirectToAutBoxGθOver_inl, semidirectToAutBoxGθOver_inr] at h
  have hx : (⟨c * θ A c⁻¹, A⟩ : SemidirectProduct G H θ)
      = SemidirectProduct.inl (c * θ A c⁻¹) * SemidirectProduct.inr A := by ext <;> simp
  rw [hx, h]

name: liftHomθOver_rebase_sectionConj
statement:
theorem liftHomθOver_rebase_sectionConj :
    OECocycle.SectionConj θ ⟨SemidirectProduct.inr, fun _ => rfl⟩
      (liftHomθOverRebaseSection d d' hact hreind H θ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨c, fun A => by
    change autBoxGθOverMulEquivSemidirect d H θ
        ((autBoxGθOverCongr d d' hact hreind H θ).symm (liftHomθOver d' H θ A)) = _
    rw [liftHomθOver_rebase_semidirect d d' hact hreind hc H θ A]
    have h := OECocycle.conj_inl_section θ (fun _ : H => (1 : G)) c A
    rw [mul_one] at h
    exact h.symm⟩

name: liftHomθOver_rebase_class
statement:
theorem liftHomθOver_rebase_class :
    Quotient.mk (OECocycle.sectionConjSetoid θ) (liftHomθOverRebaseSection d d' hact hreind H θ)
      = OECocycle.H1EquivSectionClasses θ (OECocycle.H1.trivialClass θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [OECocycle.H1EquivSectionClasses_trivialClass]
  exact (Quotient.sound (liftHomθOver_rebase_sectionConj d d' hact hreind hc H θ)).symm

name: ResidualData.twisted_presentationFunctor
statement:
theorem twisted_presentationFunctor (D : ResidualData S C G) (A : S ⥤ S) (θ : MulAut G) :
    multiplierProductFunctorθ A θ (fun _ => 1) ⋙ D.presentationFunctor =
      (D.twisted A θ).presentationFunctor
proof:
:= by
  refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) (fun X Y f => ?_)
  change (D.σ (A.obj X.1) (1 * θ Y.2.pt * (1 * θ X.2.pt)⁻¹)).hom ≫
    D.E.map (A.map f.1) =
      𝟙 _ ≫ ((D.σ (A.obj X.1) (θ (Y.2.pt * X.2.pt⁻¹))).hom ≫
        D.E.map (A.map f.1)) ≫ 𝟙 _
  simp only [one_mul, map_mul, map_inv, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: ResidualData.canonical_product_lift_eq
statement:
theorem canonical_product_lift_eq (A : S ⥤ S) (θ : MulAut G) :
    liftFunctorθ (productData S G) A θ = multiplierProductFunctorθ A θ (fun _ => 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) (fun X Y f => ?_)
  apply ProductModel.productHom_ext
  have h := Functor.congr_hom (liftθ_covers (productData S G) A θ) f
  change ((liftFunctorθ (productData S G) A θ).map f).1 =
    𝟙 _ ≫ A.map f.1 ≫ 𝟙 _ at h ⊢
  exact h

name: ResidualData.liftFunctorθ_comp_presentationFunctor
statement:
theorem liftFunctorθ_comp_presentationFunctor (D : ResidualData S C G)
    (A : S ⥤ S) (θ : MulAut G) :
    liftFunctorθ (productData S G) A θ ⋙ D.presentationFunctor =
      (D.twisted A θ).presentationFunctor

name: ResidualData.implementation_app
statement:
theorem implementation_app (D : ResidualData S C G) (A : S ⥤ S) (θ : MulAut G)
    (α : D.InvariantImplementation A θ) (s : S) (a : G) :
    α.val.hom.app (s, ⟨a⟩) = (D.implementationEquiv A θ α).val.hom.app s
proof:
:= by
  change α.val.hom.app (s, ⟨a⟩) = α.val.hom.app (s, ⟨1⟩)
  exact (invariant_iff_constant α.val.hom).mp α.property s a

name: ResidualData.invariant_implementation_iff
statement:
theorem invariant_implementation_iff (D : ResidualData S C G) (A : S ⥤ S) (θ : MulAut G) :
    Nonempty (D.InvariantImplementation A θ) ↔
      ∃ β : A ⋙ D.E ≅ D.E, ∀ (s : S) (r : G),
        (D.σ (A.obj s) (θ r)).hom ≫ β.hom.app s = β.hom.app s ≫ (D.σ s r).hom
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨α⟩
    exact ⟨(D.implementationEquiv A θ α).val, (D.implementationEquiv A θ α).property⟩
  · rintro ⟨β, hβ⟩
    exact ⟨(D.implementationEquiv A θ).symm ⟨β, hβ⟩⟩

name: ResidualData.multiplier_product_lift_eq
statement:
theorem multiplier_product_lift_eq (A : S ⥤ S) (θ : MulAut G) (k : S → G) :
    liftByMultiplierθ (productData S G) A θ k = multiplierProductFunctorθ A θ k
proof:
:= by
  refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun X => ?_) (fun X Y f => ?_)
  · simp [liftByMultiplierθ, multiplierProductFunctorθ, productData]
  · apply ProductModel.productHom_ext
    have h := Functor.congr_hom (liftByMultiplierθ_covers (productData S G) A θ k) f
    change ((liftByMultiplierθ (productData S G) A θ k).map f).1 =
      𝟙 _ ≫ A.map f.1 ≫ 𝟙 _ at h ⊢
    exact h

name: ResidualData.translated_twisted_presentationFunctor
statement:
theorem translated_twisted_presentationFunctor {K : Type*} [CommGroup K]
    (D : ResidualData S C K) (A : S ⥤ S) (θ : MulAut K) (a : K) :
    multiplierProductFunctorθ A θ (fun _ => a) ⋙ D.presentationFunctor =
      (D.twisted A θ).presentationFunctor
proof:
:= by
  refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) (fun X Y f => ?_)
  have h : a * θ Y.2.pt * (a * θ X.2.pt)⁻¹ = θ (Y.2.pt * X.2.pt⁻¹) := by
    simp [map_mul, map_inv, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
  change (D.σ (A.obj X.1) (a * θ Y.2.pt * (a * θ X.2.pt)⁻¹)).hom ≫
    D.E.map (A.map f.1) =
      𝟙 _ ≫ ((D.σ (A.obj X.1) (θ (Y.2.pt * X.2.pt⁻¹))).hom ≫
        D.E.map (A.map f.1)) ≫ 𝟙 _
  rw [h]
  simp only [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: ResidualData.translated_lift_comp_presentationFunctor
statement:
theorem translated_lift_comp_presentationFunctor {K : Type*} [CommGroup K]
    (D : ResidualData S C K) (A : S ⥤ S) (θ : MulAut K) (a : K) :
    (liftFunctorθ (productData S K) A θ ⋙ Λ (productData S K) a) ⋙
        D.presentationFunctor = (D.twisted A θ).presentationFunctor

name: ProductModel.productHom_ext
statement:
theorem productHom_ext {S : Type*} [Category S] {G : Type*} {x y : S × Pair G}
    {f g : x ⟶ y} (h : f.1 = g.1) : f = g

name: ProductModel.eqToHom_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem eqToHom_fst {S : Type*} [Category S] {G : Type*} {x y : S × Pair G}
    (h : x = y) : (eqToHom h).1 = eqToHom (congrArg Prod.fst h)

name: productData_act
statement:
@[simp] theorem productData_act (x : S × Pair G) (h : G) :
    (productData S G).act x h = (x.1, ⟨x.2.pt * h⟩)

name: productData_actHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem productData_actHom {x y : S × Pair G} (f : x ⟶ y) (h : G) :
    (productData S G).actHom f h = (f.1, ⟨⟩)

name: productData_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem productData_base (s : S) :
    (productData S G).base s = (s, ⟨1⟩)

name: productData_coord
statement:
@[simp] theorem productData_coord (x : S × Pair G) :
    (productData S G).coord x = x.2.pt

name: productData_reind
statement:
@[simp] theorem productData_reind {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : S × Pair G)
    (hy : (CategoryTheory.Prod.fst S (Pair G)).obj y = t) :
    (productData S G).reind u y hy = (s, y.2)

name: productData_chi
statement:
@[simp] theorem productData_chi {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : S × Pair G)
    (hy : (CategoryTheory.Prod.fst S (Pair G)).obj y = t) :
    (productData S G).chi u y hy = (u ≫ eqToHom hy.symm, ⟨⟩)

name: productData_ltrans
statement:
@[simp] theorem productData_ltrans (g : G) (x : S × Pair G) :
    (productData S G).ltrans g x = (𝟙 x.1, ⟨⟩)

name: productData_actFunctor
statement:
theorem productData_actFunctor (S : Type*) [Category S] (G : Type*) [Group G] (h : G) :
    (productData S G).actFunctor h = normalFormProductAction h

name: OEData.rebase_act
statement: @[simp] theorem rebase_act (d : OEData G p) (c : G) : (d.rebase c).act = d.act

name: OEData.rebase_actHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem rebase_actHom (d : OEData G p) (c : G) {x y : O} (f : x ⟶ y) (g : G) :
    (d.rebase c).actHom f g = d.actHom f g

name: OEData.rebase_reind
statement:
theorem rebase_reind (d : OEData G p) (c : G) {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O)
    (hy : p.obj y = t) : (d.rebase c).reind u y hy = d.reind u y hy

name: OEData.rebase_chi
statement:
theorem rebase_chi (d : OEData G p) (c : G) {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O)
    (hy : p.obj y = t) : (d.rebase c).chi u y hy = d.chi u y hy

name: OEData.rebase_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem rebase_base (d : OEData G p) (c : G) (s : S) :
    (d.rebase c).base s = d.act (d.base s) c

name: OEData.rebase_coord
statement:
@[simp] theorem rebase_coord (d : OEData G p) (c : G) (x : O) :
    (d.rebase c).coord x = c⁻¹ * d.coord x

name: OEData.rebase_ltrans
statement:
theorem rebase_ltrans (d : OEData G p) (c : G) (a : G) (x : O) :
    ∃ h, (d.rebase c).ltrans a x = d.ltrans (c * a * c⁻¹) x ≫ eqToHom h

name: OEData.rebase_one
statement: theorem rebase_one (d : OEData G p) : d.rebase 1 = d
proof:
:=
  OEData.ext_of_data _ _ rfl (funext fun s => d.act_one _)
    (funext fun x => by simp only [rebase_coord, inv_one, one_mul]) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)

name: OEData.rebase_rebase
statement:
theorem rebase_rebase (d : OEData G p) (c c' : G) :
    (d.rebase c).rebase c' = d.rebase (c * c')
proof:
:=
  OEData.ext_of_data _ _ rfl (funext fun s => d.act_mul _ _ _)
    (funext fun x => by simp only [rebase_coord, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)

name: parallel_basepoints_pointwise
statement:
theorem parallel_basepoints_pointwise (d d' : OEData G p) (s : S) :
    d'.base s = d.act (d.base s) (d.coord (d'.base s))
proof:
:= by
  have h := d.base_coord (d'.base s)
  rw [d'.p_base] at h
  exact h.symm

name: parallel_basepoints_locally_const
statement:
theorem parallel_basepoints_locally_const (d d' : OEData G p)
    (hreind : ∀ {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = t),
      d'.reind u y hy = d.reind u y hy)
    {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) : d.coord (d'.base s) = d.coord (d'.base t)
proof:
:= by
  have key := d'.reind_base u
  rw [hreind, d.reind_eq] at key
  rw [← key, d.coord_base]

name: parallel_basepoints_const_unique
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s₀⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty S)
  exact d.act_free _ _ _ ((hc s₀).symm.trans (hc' s₀))

name: parallel_family_eq_translate
statement:
theorem parallel_family_eq_translate [IsConnected S] (d : OEData G p) (b' : S → O)
    (hp : ∀ s, p.obj (b' s) = s)
    (hpar : ∀ {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t), d.reind u (b' t) (hp t) = b' s) :
    ∃! c : G, ∀ s, b' s = d.act (d.base s) c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s₀⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty S)
  have hpt : ∀ s, b' s = d.act (d.base s) (d.coord (b' s)) := fun s => by
    have h := d.base_coord (b' s); rw [hp] at h; exact h.symm
  have hloc : ∀ {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t), d.coord (b' s) = d.coord (b' t) := fun u => by
    have key := hpar u
    rw [d.reind_eq] at key
    rw [← key, d.coord_base]
  have hconst : ∀ s, d.coord (b' s) = d.coord (b' s₀) := fun s =>
    constant_of_preserves_morphisms (fun s => d.coord (b' s)) (fun _ _ u => hloc u) s s₀
  refine ⟨d.coord (b' s₀), fun s => by rw [← hconst s]; exact hpt s, fun c hc => ?_⟩
  rw [hc s₀, d.coord_base]

name: parallel_family_eq_rebase_base
statement:
theorem parallel_family_eq_rebase_base [IsConnected S] (d : OEData G p) (b' : S → O)
    (hp : ∀ s, p.obj (b' s) = s)
    (hpar : ∀ {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t), d.reind u (b' t) (hp t) = b' s) :
    ∃! c : G, (d.rebase c).base = b'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hu⟩ := parallel_family_eq_translate d b' hp hpar
  exact ⟨c, funext fun s => (hc s).symm, fun c' h => hu c' fun s => by rw [← h]; rfl⟩

name: parallel_basepoints_eq_rebase
statement:
theorem parallel_basepoints_eq_rebase [IsConnected S] (d d' : OEData G p)
    (_hact : ∀ x g, d'.act x g = d.act x g)
    (hreind : ∀ {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = t),
      d'.reind u y hy = d.reind u y hy) :
    ∃! c : G, ∀ s, d'.base s = d.act (d.base s) c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s₀⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty S)
  have hconst : ∀ s, d.coord (d'.base s) = d.coord (d'.base s₀) := fun s =>
    constant_of_preserves_morphisms (fun s => d.coord (d'.base s))
      (fun _ _ u => parallel_basepoints_locally_const d d' hreind u) s s₀
  refine ⟨d.coord (d'.base s₀), fun s => ?_, fun c hc => ?_⟩
  · rw [← hconst s]
    exact parallel_basepoints_pointwise d d' s
  · have h := hc s₀
    rw [h, d.coord_base]

name: coord_eq_of_base
statement:
theorem coord_eq_of_base (d d' : OEData G p) (hact : ∀ x g, d'.act x g = d.act x g)
    {c : G} (hc : ∀ s, d'.base s = d.act (d.base s) c) (x : O) :
    d'.coord x = c⁻¹ * d.coord x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : d.act (d.base (p.obj x)) (c * d'.coord x) = x := by
    rw [← d.act_mul, ← hc, ← hact, d'.base_coord]
  have h2 := congrArg d.coord h1
  rw [d.coord_base] at h2
  rw [← h2, inv_mul_cancel_left]

name: eq_rebase_of_base
statement:
theorem eq_rebase_of_base (d d' : OEData G p) (hact : ∀ x g, d'.act x g = d.act x g)
    (hreind : ∀ {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = t),
      d'.reind u y hy = d.reind u y hy)
    {c : G} (hc : ∀ s, d'.base s = d.act (d.base s) c) : d' = d.rebase c
proof:
:=
  OEData.ext_of_data d' (d.rebase c) (funext fun x => funext fun g => hact x g) (funext hc)
    (funext (coord_eq_of_base d d' hact hc)) hreind

name: exists_unique_eq_rebase
statement:
theorem exists_unique_eq_rebase [IsConnected S] (d d' : OEData G p)
    (hact : ∀ x g, d'.act x g = d.act x g)
    (hreind : ∀ {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = t),
      d'.reind u y hy = d.reind u y hy) :
    ∃! c : G, d' = d.rebase c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, _⟩ := parallel_basepoints_eq_rebase d d' hact hreind
  refine ⟨c, eq_rebase_of_base d d' hact hreind hc, fun c' hc' => ?_⟩
  have hb : ∀ s, d'.base s = d.act (d.base s) c' := fun s => by rw [hc']; rfl
  exact parallel_basepoints_const_unique d d' hb hc

name: Λ_eq_of_base
statement:
theorem Λ_eq_of_base (d d' : OEData G p) (hact : ∀ x g, d'.act x g = d.act x g)
    {c : G} (hc : ∀ s, d'.base s = d.act (d.base s) c) (a : G) :
    Λ d' a = Λ d (c * a * c⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  refine funct_ext d (fun x => ?_) (by rw [Λ_comp_p, Λ_comp_p])
  show d'.act (d'.base (p.obj x)) (a * d'.coord x)
    = d.act (d.base (p.obj x)) (c * a * c⁻¹ * d.coord x)
  rw [hact, hc, d.act_mul, coord_eq_of_base d d' hact hc]
  congr 1
  group

name: Λ_eq_conj_of_base
statement:
theorem Λ_eq_conj_of_base (d d' : OEData G p) (hact : ∀ x g, d'.act x g = d.act x g)
    {c : G} (hc : ∀ s, d'.base s = d.act (d.base s) c) (a : G) :
    Λ d' a = Λ d c⁻¹ ⋙ Λ d a ⋙ Λ d c
proof:
:= by
  rw [Λ_eq_of_base d d' hact hc, Λ_comp, Λ_comp]

name: liftFunctor_eq_of_base
statement:
theorem liftFunctor_eq_of_base (d d' : OEData G p) (hact : ∀ x g, d'.act x g = d.act x g)
    {c : G} (hc : ∀ s, d'.base s = d.act (d.base s) c) (A : S ⥤ S) :
    liftFunctor d' A = liftFunctor d A
proof:
:= by
  refine funct_ext d (fun x => ?_)
    (by rw [(lift_preservesCleavage d' A).covers, (lift_preservesCleavage d A).covers])
  show d'.act (d'.base (A.obj (p.obj x))) (d'.coord x)
    = d.act (d.base (A.obj (p.obj x))) (d.coord x)
  rw [hact, hc, d.act_mul, coord_eq_of_base d d' hact hc, mul_inv_cancel_left]

name: liftFunctorθ_obj_eq_of_base
statement:
theorem liftFunctorθ_obj_eq_of_base (d d' : OEData G p) (hact : ∀ x g, d'.act x g = d.act x g)
    {c : G} (hc : ∀ s, d'.base s = d.act (d.base s) c) (A : S ⥤ S) (θ : MulAut G) (x : O) :
    d'.act (d'.base (A.obj (p.obj x))) (θ (d'.coord x))
      = d.act (d.base (A.obj (p.obj x))) (c * θ c⁻¹ * θ (d.coord x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hact, hc, d.act_mul, coord_eq_of_base d d' hact hc, map_mul, mul_assoc]

name: liftFunctorθ_eq_of_base
statement:
theorem liftFunctorθ_eq_of_base (d d' : OEData G p) (hact : ∀ x g, d'.act x g = d.act x g)
    {c : G} (hc : ∀ s, d'.base s = d.act (d.base s) c) (A : S ⥤ S) (θ : MulAut G) :
    liftFunctorθ d' A θ = liftFunctorθ d A θ ⋙ Λ d (c * θ c⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  refine funct_ext d (fun x => ?_)
    (by rw [liftθ_covers, Functor.assoc, Λ_comp_p, liftθ_covers])
  show d'.act (d'.base (A.obj (p.obj x))) (θ (d'.coord x))
    = d.act (d.base (p.obj (d.act (d.base (A.obj (p.obj x))) (θ (d.coord x)))))
        (c * θ c⁻¹ * d.coord (d.act (d.base (A.obj (p.obj x))) (θ (d.coord x))))
  rw [liftFunctorθ_obj_eq_of_base d d' hact hc, d.p_act, d.p_base, d.coord_base]

name: liftFunctorθ_eq_conj_of_base
statement:
theorem liftFunctorθ_eq_conj_of_base (d d' : OEData G p)
    (hact : ∀ x g, d'.act x g = d.act x g)
    {c : G} (hc : ∀ s, d'.base s = d.act (d.base s) c) (A : S ⥤ S) (θ : MulAut G) :
    liftFunctorθ d' A θ = Λ d c⁻¹ ⋙ liftFunctorθ d A θ ⋙ Λ d c
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftFunctorθ_eq_of_base d d' hact hc, ← Functor.assoc, Λ_comp_liftθ, Functor.assoc,
    Λ_comp]

name: Λ_rebase
statement: theorem Λ_rebase (d : OEData G p) (c a : G) : Λ (d.rebase c) a = Λ d (c * a * c⁻¹)
proof:
:=
  Λ_eq_of_base d (d.rebase c) (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) a

name: liftFunctor_rebase
statement:
theorem liftFunctor_rebase (d : OEData G p) (c : G) (A : S ⥤ S) :
    liftFunctor (d.rebase c) A = liftFunctor d A
proof:
:=
  liftFunctor_eq_of_base d (d.rebase c) (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) A

name: liftFunctorθ_rebase
statement:
theorem liftFunctorθ_rebase (d : OEData G p) (c : G) (A : S ⥤ S) (θ : MulAut G) :
    liftFunctorθ (d.rebase c) A θ = liftFunctorθ d A θ ⋙ Λ d (c * θ c⁻¹)
proof:
:=
  liftFunctorθ_eq_of_base d (d.rebase c) (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) A θ

name: isGEquivariant_iff_of_act_eq
statement:
theorem isGEquivariant_iff_of_act_eq (d d' : OEData G p)
    (hact : ∀ x g, d'.act x g = d.act x g) (F : O ⥤ O) :
    IsGEquivariant d' F ↔ IsGEquivariant d F

name: isTwistedEquivariant_iff_of_act_eq
statement:
theorem isTwistedEquivariant_iff_of_act_eq (d d' : OEData G p)
    (hact : ∀ x g, d'.act x g = d.act x g) (θ : MulAut G) (F : O ⥤ O) :
    IsTwistedEquivariant d' θ F ↔ IsTwistedEquivariant d θ F

name: preservesCleavage_iff_of_reind_eq
statement:
theorem preservesCleavage_iff_of_reind_eq (d d' : OEData G p)
    (hreind : ∀ {s t : S} (u : s ⟶ t) (y : O) (hy : p.obj y = t),
      d'.reind u y hy = d.reind u y hy) (F : O ⥤ O) (A : S ⥤ S) :
    PreservesCleavage d' F A ↔ PreservesCleavage d F A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.covers, fun u y hy => by rw [← hreind, ← hreind]; exact h.src u y hy⟩
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.covers, fun u y hy => by rw [hreind, hreind]; exact h.src u y hy⟩

name: autBoxGCongr_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem autBoxGCongr_hom (e : AutBoxG d) :
    (autBoxGCongr d d' hact hreind e).hom = e.hom

name: autBoxGCongr_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem autBoxGCongr_inv (e : AutBoxG d) :
    (autBoxGCongr d d' hact hreind e).inv = e.inv
