  refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) (fun X Y f => ?_)
  change (1 : CategoryTheory.Aut (L.obj X.1)).hom ≫ L.map f.1 =
    𝟙 _ ≫ L.map f.1 ≫ 𝟙 _
  simp

name: ResidualData.prescribed_iso_iff
statement:
theorem prescribed_iso_iff (D : ResidualData S C G) (L : S ⥤ C) :
    Nonempty (D.presentationFunctor ≅ CategoryTheory.Prod.fst S (Pair G) ⋙ L) ↔
      Nonempty (D.E ≅ L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← trivial_presentationFunctor (G := G) L]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨α⟩ => ⟨restrictComparisonIso α⟩,
    fun ⟨β⟩ => ⟨comparisonIso β⟩⟩

name: ResidualData.prescribed_invariant_iso_iff
statement:
theorem prescribed_invariant_iso_iff (D : ResidualData S C G) (L : S ⥤ C) :
    (∃ α : D.presentationFunctor ≅ (trivial (G := G) L).presentationFunctor,
      IsInvariantNatTrans (productData S G) D.presentationFunctor_isInvariant
        (trivial L).presentationFunctor_isInvariant α.hom) ↔
      Nonempty (D.E ≅ L) ∧ ∀ s, D.σ s = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨α, hα⟩
    let β := restrictComparisonIso α
    refine ⟨⟨β⟩, fun s => ?_⟩
    have hcomp : comparison β.hom = α.hom := comparison_restrictComparison α.hom
    have hint := (comparison_invariant_iff β.hom).mp (hcomp.symm ▸ hα)
    exact (Calibration.action_trivial_iff_of_intertwining (D.σ s) 1 (β.app s)
      (hint s)).mpr rfl
  · rintro ⟨⟨β⟩, hσ⟩
    refine ⟨comparisonIso β, ?_⟩
    apply (comparison_invariant_iff (D := D) (D' := trivial L) β.hom).mpr
    intro s r
    rw [hσ s]
    change 𝟙 _ ≫ β.hom.app s = β.hom.app s ≫ 𝟙 _
    simp

name: TwistExample.c2Hom_one'
statement:
@[simp] theorem c2Hom_one' [DecidableEq A] (a : A) (hA : ∀ x : A, x = 1 ∨ x = a) (ha : a ≠ 1)

    (hB : ∀ y : B, y = 1 ∨ y = b) (hb : b ≠ 1) (hbb : b * b = 1) :
    c2MulEquiv a hA ha haa b hB hb hbb a = b

name: mem_twistH
statement: theorem mem_twistH {B : StrictAut (Pair (Fin 2))} : B ∈ twistH ↔ B = 1 ∨ B = swapAut
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hB
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.1 hB
    obtain ⟨m, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.even_or_odd' k
    · left
      rw [zpow_mul, zpow_two, swapAut_mul_self, one_zpow]
    · right
      rw [zpow_add_one, zpow_mul, zpow_two, swapAut_mul_self, one_zpow, one_mul]
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact one_mem _
    · exact Subgroup.mem_zpowers _

name: twistH_cases
statement: theorem twistH_cases (B : twistH) : B = 1 ∨ B = twistHSwap
proof:
:= by
  rcases mem_twistH.1 B.2 with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext h)
  · exact Or.inr (Subtype.ext h)

name: twistθ_swap

name: c3c2ToS3_compat
statement:
theorem c3c2ToS3_compat (g : Multiplicative (ZMod 2)) :
    c3ToS3.comp (twistθC2 g).toMonoidHom
      = (MulAut.conj (c2ToS3 g)).toMonoidHom.comp c3ToS3
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (g : Multiplicative (ZMod 2)) (n : G3),
      c3ToS3 (twistθC2 g n) = c2ToS3 g * c3ToS3 n * (c2ToS3 g)⁻¹ := by decide
  exact MonoidHom.ext fun n => key g n

name: c3c2ToS3_bijective
statement: theorem c3c2ToS3_bijective : Function.Bijective c3c2ToS3
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : ∀ (a c : G3) (b e : Multiplicative (ZMod 2)),
      c3ToS3 a * c2ToS3 b = c3ToS3 c * c2ToS3 e → a = c ∧ b = e := by decide
  have hsurj : ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), ∃ a : G3, ∃ b : Multiplicative (ZMod 2),
      c3ToS3 a * c2ToS3 b = σ := by decide
  refine ⟨fun x y hxy => ?_, fun σ => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hinj x.left y.left x.right y.right hxy
    exact SemidirectProduct.ext h1 h2
  · obtain ⟨a, b, h⟩ := hsurj σ
    exact ⟨⟨a, b⟩, h⟩

name: twistSemidirectH_apply_semidirectTo
statement:
theorem twistSemidirectH_apply_semidirectTo (x : SemidirectProduct G3 twistH twistθ) :
    twistSemidirectH (semidirectToAutBoxGθOver twistData twistH twistθ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  unfold twistSemidirectH autBoxGθOverMulEquivSemidirect
  exact MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ x

name: twistSymPerm_Λ
statement:
theorem twistSymPerm_Λ (g : G3) :
    twistSymPerm (ΛHomθOver twistData twistH twistθ g) = c3ToS3 g
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ΛHomθOver twistData twistH twistθ g
      = semidirectToAutBoxGθOver twistData twistH twistθ (SemidirectProduct.inl g) :=
    (semidirectToAutBoxGθOver_inl _ _ _ g).symm
  have h2 : twistSemidirectC2 (SemidirectProduct.inl g) = SemidirectProduct.inl g := by
    ext
    · rfl
    · show twistHMulEquiv 1 = 1
      exact map_one _
  rw [twistSymPerm, twistSym, MulEquiv.trans_apply, MulEquiv.trans_apply, h1,
    twistSemidirectH_apply_semidirectTo, h2]
  exact SemidirectProduct.lift_inl c3ToS3 c2ToS3 c3c2ToS3_compat g

name: twistSymPerm_Λ_r

theorem twistSymPerm_Λ_r :

name: twistSymPerm_lift
statement:
theorem twistSymPerm_lift :
    twistSymPerm (liftHomθOver twistData twistH twistθ twistHSwap) = Equiv.swap 0 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : liftHomθOver twistData twistH twistθ twistHSwap
      = semidirectToAutBoxGθOver twistData twistH twistθ (SemidirectProduct.inr twistHSwap) :=
    (semidirectToAutBoxGθOver_inr _ _ _ twistHSwap).symm
  have h2 : twistSemidirectC2 (SemidirectProduct.inr twistHSwap) = SemidirectProduct.inr c2Gen := by
    ext
    · rfl
    · exact twistHMulEquiv_swap
  rw [twistSymPerm, twistSym, MulEquiv.trans_apply, MulEquiv.trans_apply, h1,
    twistSemidirectH_apply_semidirectTo, h2]
  exact (SemidirectProduct.lift_inr c3ToS3 c2ToS3 c3c2ToS3_compat c2Gen).trans
    (c2Hom_gen _ _ _ _ _ _)

name: twistLift_obj
statement:
theorem twistLift_obj (s : Pair (Fin 2)) (g : G3) :
    (liftHomθOver twistData twistH twistθ twistHSwap).hom.obj (s, ⟨g⟩)
      = (swapAut.hom.obj s, ⟨g⁻¹⟩)
proof:
:= by
  show ((⟨Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1 s.pt⟩ : Pair (Fin 2)), (⟨1 * twistθ twistHSwap g⟩ : Pair G3))
    = _
  rw [twistθ_swap_apply, one_mul]
  rfl

name: twist_conj
statement:
theorem twist_conj (g : G3) :
    liftHomθOver twistData twistH twistθ twistHSwap * ΛHomθOver twistData twistH twistθ g
        * (liftHomθOver twistData twistH twistθ twistHSwap)⁻¹
      = ΛHomθOver twistData twistH twistθ g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun (liftHomθOver_conj twistData twistH twistθ twistHSwap) g
  simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, MulAut.conj_apply,
    twistθ_swap_apply] at h
  exact h.symm

      = ΛHomθOver twistData twistH twistθ twistR⁻¹

statement:
theorem s3_left_ne_right :

name: s3_Λ_obj
statement:
theorem s3_Λ_obj :
    (Λ (witness (Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))) (Equiv.swap 0 1)).obj ⟨Equiv.swap 1 2⟩ = ⟨c[0, 1, 2]⟩
proof:
:= by
  show (⟨1 * (Equiv.swap 0 1 * Equiv.swap 1 2)⟩ : Pair (Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))) = _
  rw [one_mul, s3_swap01_mul_swap12]

name: s3_actFunctor_obj
statement:
theorem s3_actFunctor_obj :
    ((witness (Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))).actFunctor (Equiv.swap 0 1)).obj ⟨Equiv.swap 1 2⟩
      = ⟨c[0, 2, 1]⟩

name: s3_Λ_ne_actFunctor
statement:
theorem s3_Λ_ne_actFunctor :
    Λ (witness (Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))) (Equiv.swap 0 1)
      ≠ (witness (Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))).actFunctor (Equiv.swap 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' := congrArg (fun F => F.obj (⟨Equiv.swap 1 2⟩ : Pair (Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)))) h
  simp only [s3_Λ_obj, s3_actFunctor_obj] at h'
  exact absurd (congrArg Pair.pt h') (by decide)

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x1, ⟨a⟩⟩ := x
  obtain ⟨y1, ⟨b⟩⟩ := y
  cases x1; cases y1
  cases h

statement: theorem singleObj_eqToHom {a b : SingleObj Γ} (h : a = b) : eqToHom h = (1 : Γ)

name: holEqToHom_fst
statement: theorem holEqToHom_fst {x y : HolTotal Γ G} (h : x = y) : ((eqToHom h).1 : Γ) = 1

name: holHom_ext
statement: theorem holHom_ext {x y : HolTotal Γ G} {f g : x ⟶ y} (h : (f.1 : Γ) = g.1) : f = g

name: holReind_id
statement:
theorem holReind_id (ρ : Γ →* G) (s : SingleObj Γ) (y : HolTotal Γ G) :
    holReind ρ (𝟙 s) y = y
proof:
:= by
  apply holTotal_ext
  show (ρ (1 : Γ))⁻¹ * y.2.pt = y.2.pt
  rw [map_one, inv_one, one_mul]

name: holReind_comp
statement:
theorem holReind_comp (ρ : Γ →* G) {s t r : SingleObj Γ} (γ : s ⟶ t) (δ : t ⟶ r)
    (y : HolTotal Γ G) : holReind ρ (γ ≫ δ) y = holReind ρ γ (holReind ρ δ y)
proof:
:= by
  apply holTotal_ext
  show (ρ (δ * γ))⁻¹ * y.2.pt = (ρ γ)⁻¹ * ((ρ δ)⁻¹ * y.2.pt)
  rw [map_mul, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]

name: holChi_id
statement:
theorem holChi_id (ρ : Γ →* G) (s : SingleObj Γ) (y : HolTotal Γ G) :
    holChi ρ (𝟙 s) y = eqToHom (holReind_id ρ s y)

name: holChi_comp
statement:
theorem holChi_comp (ρ : Γ →* G) {s t r : SingleObj Γ} (γ : s ⟶ t) (δ : t ⟶ r)
    (y : HolTotal Γ G) :
    holChi ρ (γ ≫ δ) y
      = eqToHom (holReind_comp ρ γ δ y) ≫ holChi ρ γ (holReind ρ δ y) ≫ holChi ρ δ y
proof:
:= by
  apply holHom_ext
  show ((γ ≫ δ : s ⟶ r) : Γ) = (eqToHom (holReind_comp ρ γ δ y)).1 ≫ (γ ≫ δ)
  rw [holEqToHom_fst]
  show δ * γ = (δ * γ) * 1
  rw [mul_one]

name: holReind_act
statement:
theorem holReind_act (ρ : Γ →* G) {s t : SingleObj Γ} (γ : s ⟶ t) (y : HolTotal Γ G)
    (h : G) : holReind ρ γ (holAct y h) = holAct (holReind ρ γ y) h
proof:
:= by
  apply holTotal_ext
  show (ρ γ)⁻¹ * (y.2.pt * h) = (ρ γ)⁻¹ * y.2.pt * h
  rw [mul_assoc]

name: holChi_act
statement:
theorem holChi_act (ρ : Γ →* G) {s t : SingleObj Γ} (γ : s ⟶ t) (y : HolTotal Γ G) (h : G) :
    holChi ρ γ (holAct y h)
      = eqToHom (holReind_act ρ γ y h)
          ≫ (normalFormProductAction (S := SingleObj Γ) h).map (holChi ρ γ y)
proof:
:= by
  apply holHom_ext
  show (γ : Γ) = (eqToHom (holReind_act ρ γ y h)).1 ≫ γ
  rw [holEqToHom_fst]
  show γ = γ * 1
  rw [mul_one]

name: holReind_holBase_iff
statement:
theorem holReind_holBase_iff (ρ : Γ →* G) :
    (∀ {s t : SingleObj Γ} (γ : s ⟶ t), holReind ρ γ (holBase t) = holBase s) ↔ ρ = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext γ
    have h1 := congrArg (fun x : HolTotal Γ G => x.2.pt)
      (h (s := SingleObj.star Γ) (t := SingleObj.star Γ) γ)
    simp only [holReind_pt, holBase, mul_one, inv_eq_one] at h1
    simpa using h1
  · rintro rfl s t γ
    apply holTotal_ext
    show ((1 : Γ →* G) γ)⁻¹ * 1 = 1
    simp

name: holAct_one
statement: theorem holAct_one (x : HolTotal Γ G) : holAct x 1 = x

name: holAct_mul
statement: theorem holAct_mul (x : HolTotal Γ G) (g h : G) : holAct (holAct x g) h = holAct x (g * h)

theorem holP_holAct (x : HolTotal Γ G) (g : G) :

name: holAct_functor_one
statement:
theorem holAct_functor_one :
    normalFormProductAction (S := SingleObj Γ) (1 : G) = 𝟭 (HolTotal Γ G)
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => holTotal_ext (mul_one _)) (fun _ _ _ => holHom_ext (by
    simp only [Functor.id_map, prod_comp_fst]; rw [holEqToHom_fst, holEqToHom_fst]
    simp only [SingleObj.comp_as_mul, mul_one, one_mul]; rfl))

name: holAct_functor_mul
statement:
theorem holAct_functor_mul (g h : G) :
    normalFormProductAction (S := SingleObj Γ) g ⋙ normalFormProductAction h
      = normalFormProductAction (g * h)
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => holTotal_ext (mul_assoc _ _ _)) (fun _ _ _ => holHom_ext (by
    simp only [Functor.comp_map, prod_comp_fst]; rw [holEqToHom_fst, holEqToHom_fst]
    simp only [SingleObj.comp_as_mul, mul_one, one_mul]; rfl))

statement:
theorem holP_act_functor (g : G) :
    normalFormProductAction (S := SingleObj Γ) g ⋙ holP Γ G = holP Γ G

statement:
theorem holBase_coord (x : HolTotal Γ G) :
    holAct (holBase ((holP Γ G).obj x)) (holCoord x) = x

name: holCoord_holAct_holBase

theorem holCoord_holAct_holBase (s : SingleObj Γ) (g : G) :

name: holP_map_holLtrans
statement:
theorem holP_map_holLtrans (a : G) (x : HolTotal Γ G) :

statement: theorem holLtrans_isIso (a : G) (x : HolTotal Γ G) : IsIso (holLtrans a x).hom

name: holP_faithful
statement: theorem holP_faithful : (holP Γ G).Faithful

name: holonomy_N1_N2_N5_N6
statement:
theorem holonomy_N1_N2_N5_N6 :
    ((∀ x : HolTotal Γ G, holAct x 1 = x) ∧
      (∀ (x : HolTotal Γ G) (g h : G), holAct (holAct x g) h = holAct x (g * h)) ∧
      (∀ (x : HolTotal Γ G) (g : G), (holP Γ G).obj (holAct x g) = (holP Γ G).obj x) ∧
      normalFormProductAction (S := SingleObj Γ) (1 : G) = 𝟭 (HolTotal Γ G) ∧
      (∀ g h : G, normalFormProductAction (S := SingleObj Γ) g ⋙ normalFormProductAction h
        = normalFormProductAction (g * h)) ∧
      (∀ g : G, normalFormProductAction (S := SingleObj Γ) g ⋙ holP Γ G = holP Γ G)) ∧
    ((∀ s : SingleObj Γ, (holP Γ G).obj (holBase (G := G) s) = s) ∧
      (∀ x : HolTotal Γ G, holAct (holBase ((holP Γ G).obj x)) (holCoord x) = x) ∧
      (∀ (s : SingleObj Γ) (g : G), holCoord (holAct (holBase s) g) = g)) ∧
    (∀ (a : G) (x : HolTotal Γ G), (holP Γ G).map (holLtrans a x).hom = 𝟙 _) ∧
    (holP Γ G).Faithful
proof:
:=
  
  ⟨⟨holAct_one, holAct_mul, fun _ _ => rfl, holAct_functor_one, holAct_functor_mul,
      holP_act_functor⟩,
    ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ => holTotal_ext (one_mul _), holCoord_holAct_holBase⟩,
    holP_map_holLtrans, holP_faithful⟩

name: holonomy_not_normalized
statement:
theorem holonomy_not_normalized (ρ : Γ →* G) (hρ : ρ ≠ 1) :
    ¬ ∃ d : NormalizedPreDatum G (holP Γ G),
      (∀ {s t : SingleObj Γ} (γ : s ⟶ t) (y : HolTotal Γ G) (hy : (holP Γ G).obj y = t),
        d.reind γ y hy = holReind ρ γ y) ∧ ∀ s, d.base s = holBase s
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨d, hr, hb⟩
  apply hρ
  rw [← holReind_holBase_iff]
  intro s t γ
  have h := d.reind_base γ
  rw [hr, hb, hb] at h
  exact h

name: holonomy_not_OEData
statement:
theorem holonomy_not_OEData (ρ : Γ →* G) (hρ : ρ ≠ 1) :
    ¬ ∃ d : OEData G (holP Γ G),
      (∀ {s t : SingleObj Γ} (γ : s ⟶ t) (y : HolTotal Γ G) (hy : (holP Γ G).obj y = t),
        d.reind γ y hy = holReind ρ γ y) ∧ ∀ s, d.base s = holBase s
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨d, hr, hb⟩
  apply hρ
  rw [← holReind_holBase_iff]
  intro s t γ
  have h := d.reind_base γ
  rw [hr, hb, hb] at h
  exact h

name: holFunctor_ext
proof:
:= by
  refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext hobj (fun x y f => ?_)
  apply holHom_ext
  show ((F.map f).1 : Γ)
    = ((eqToHom (hobj y).symm).1 * (F'.map f).1) * (eqToHom (hobj x)).1
  rw [holEqToHom_fst, holEqToHom_fst, mul_one, one_mul, hmap]

name: mem_HolLift
statement:
theorem mem_HolLift (ρ : Γ →* G) (e : StrictAut (HolTotal Γ G) × StrictAut (SingleObj Γ)) :
    e ∈ HolLift ρ ↔ IsHolLift ρ e.1.hom e.2.hom

name: IsHolLift.obj_pt
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x = holAct (holBase (SingleObj.star Γ)) x.2.pt :=
    holTotal_ext (by show x.2.pt = 1 * x.2.pt; rw [one_mul])
  calc (F.obj x).2.pt = (F.obj (holAct (holBase (SingleObj.star Γ)) x.2.pt)).2.pt :=
        congrArg (fun z => (F.obj z).2.pt) hx
    _ = _ := by rw [hF.equiv]; rfl

name: IsHolLift.map_fst
proof:
:= by
  have h := Functor.congr_hom hF.covers f
  rw [SingleObj.comp_as_mul, SingleObj.comp_as_mul, singleObj_eqToHom, singleObj_eqToHom,
    one_mul, mul_one] at h
  exact h

name: IsHolLift.map_holChi
statement:
theorem IsHolLift.map_holChi {ρ : Γ →* G} {F : HolTotal Γ G ⥤ HolTotal Γ G}
    {A : SingleObj Γ ⥤ SingleObj Γ} (hF : IsHolLift ρ F A) {s t : SingleObj Γ} (γ : s ⟶ t)
    (y : HolTotal Γ G) :
    F.map (holChi ρ γ y) = eqToHom (hF.pres γ y) ≫ holChi ρ (A.map γ) (F.obj y)
proof:
:= by
  apply holHom_ext
  rw [hF.map_fst]
  show A.map γ = A.map γ * (eqToHom (hF.pres γ y)).1
  rw [holEqToHom_fst, mul_one]

name: mem_Eρ
statement:
theorem mem_Eρ (ρ : Γ →* G) (e : G × MulAut Γ) :
    e ∈ Eρ ρ ↔ ∀ γ : Γ, ρ (e.2 γ) = e.1 * ρ γ * e.1⁻¹

name: mem_Hρ_iff_conj
statement:
theorem mem_Hρ_iff_conj (ρ : Γ →* G) (α : MulAut Γ) :
    α ∈ Hρ ρ ↔ ∃ k : G, ρ.comp α.toMonoidHom = (MulAut.conj k).toMonoidHom.comp ρ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    exact ⟨k, MonoidHom.ext fun γ => by simpa [MulAut.conj_apply] using hk γ⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    exact ⟨k, fun γ => by simpa [MulAut.conj_apply] using DFunLike.congr_fun hk γ⟩

name: θSingleObjEquiv_holBaseAut
statement:
@[simp] theorem θSingleObjEquiv_holBaseAut (α : MulAut Γ) :
    θSingleObjEquiv Γ (holBaseAut α) = α

name: IsHolLift.mem_Eρ
proof:
:= by
  intro γ
  have h1 := congrArg (fun z : HolTotal Γ G => z.2.pt)
    (hF.pres (s := SingleObj.star Γ) (t := SingleObj.star Γ) γ (holBase (SingleObj.star Γ)))
  simp only [holReind_pt] at h1
  rw [hF.obj_pt (holReind ρ (s := SingleObj.star Γ) (t := SingleObj.star Γ) γ
    (holBase (SingleObj.star Γ))), holReind_pt] at h1
  show ρ (A.hom.map (X := SingleObj.star Γ) (Y := SingleObj.star Γ) γ)
    = (F.obj (holBase (SingleObj.star Γ))).2.pt * ρ γ * (F.obj (holBase (SingleObj.star Γ))).2.pt⁻¹
  generalize (F.obj (holBase (SingleObj.star Γ))).2.pt = k at h1 ⊢
  generalize ρ (A.hom.map (X := SingleObj.star Γ) (Y := SingleObj.star Γ) γ) = r at h1 ⊢
  have h2 : r⁻¹ = k * (ρ γ)⁻¹ * k⁻¹ := by
    apply eq_mul_inv_of_mul_eq
    rw [← h1]
    show k * ((ρ γ)⁻¹ * 1) = k * (ρ γ)⁻¹
    rw [mul_one]
  rw [← inv_inj, h2]
  group

name: holLiftAut_mem
statement:
theorem holLiftAut_mem {ρ : Γ →* G} {k : G} {α : MulAut Γ} (h : (k, α) ∈ Eρ ρ) :
    (holLiftAut k α, holBaseAut α) ∈ HolLift ρ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨rfl, fun x g => ?_, fun γ y => ?_⟩
  · apply holTotal_ext
    show k * (x.2.pt * g) = k * x.2.pt * g
    rw [mul_assoc]
  · apply holTotal_ext
    have hγ : ρ (α γ) = k * ρ γ * k⁻¹ := h γ
    show k * ((ρ γ)⁻¹ * y.2.pt) = (ρ (α γ))⁻¹ * (k * y.2.pt)
    rw [hγ]
    group

proof:
:= by

  · rintro ⟨e, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨e.1.1, e.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩

name: EρToHρ_ker

name: centralizerToEρ_injective
statement: theorem centralizerToEρ_injective (ρ : Γ →* G) : Function.Injective (centralizerToEρ ρ)

:=
  fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun e : Eρ ρ => e.1.1) h)

name: centralizerToEρ_range
statement: theorem centralizerToEρ_range (ρ : Γ →* G) : (centralizerToEρ ρ).range = (EρProj ρ).ker
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_range, MonoidHom.mem_ker, EρProj_apply]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rfl
  · intro he
    refine ⟨⟨e.1.1, Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff.mpr ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · intro h hh
      obtain ⟨γ, rfl⟩ := MonoidHom.mem_range.mp hh
      have hγ := e.2 γ
      rw [he, MulAut.one_apply] at hγ
      calc ρ γ * e.1.1 = e.1.1 * ρ γ * e.1.1⁻¹ * e.1.1 := by rw [← hγ]
        _ = e.1.1 * ρ γ := by group
    · apply Subtype.ext
      exact Prod.ext rfl he.symm

name: holonomy_exact
statement:
theorem holonomy_exact (ρ : Γ →* G) :

statement:
theorem centralizerToHolLift_range (ρ : Γ →* G) :
    (centralizerToHolLift ρ).range = (holLiftProj ρ).ker
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, holLiftProj_eq_one_iff, ← MonoidHom.mem_ker, ← centralizerToEρ_range,
    MonoidHom.mem_range, MonoidHom.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨k, by rw [centralizerToHolLift_apply, MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply]⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    rw [centralizerToHolLift_apply, hk, MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: holLiftProj_range
statement:
theorem holLiftProj_range (ρ : Γ →* G) :
    (holLiftProj ρ).range = (Hρ ρ).comap (θSingleObjEquiv Γ).toMonoidHom
proof:
:= by
  ext A
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_range, Subgroup.mem_comap]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(holLiftEquiv ρ e).1.1, (holLiftEquiv ρ e).2⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨(holLiftEquiv ρ).symm ⟨(k, θSingleObjEquiv Γ A), hk⟩, ?_⟩
    apply (θSingleObjEquiv Γ).injective
    rw [← EρProj_holLiftEquiv, MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl

name: holLift_exact
statement:
theorem holLift_exact (ρ : Γ →* G) :
    Function.Injective (centralizerToHolLift ρ) ∧
      (centralizerToHolLift ρ).range = (holLiftProj ρ).ker ∧
      (holLiftProj ρ).range = (Hρ ρ).comap (θSingleObjEquiv Γ).toMonoidHom

name: holLiftAut_one_mem_iff
statement:
theorem holLiftAut_one_mem_iff (ρ : Γ →* G) (k : G) :
    (holLiftAut k (1 : MulAut Γ), holBaseAut (1 : MulAut Γ)) ∈ HolLift ρ ↔
      k ∈ Subgroup.centralizer (ρ.range : Set G)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hE := IsHolLift.mem_Eρ (ρ := ρ) (A := holBaseAut 1) h
    rw [Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff]
    intro r hr
    obtain ⟨γ, rfl⟩ := MonoidHom.mem_range.mp hr
    have hγ : ρ ((θSingleObjEquiv Γ (holBaseAut 1)) γ) = (k * 1) * ρ γ * (k * 1)⁻¹ := hE γ
    rw [θSingleObjEquiv_holBaseAut, MulAut.one_apply, mul_one] at hγ
    calc ρ γ * k = k * ρ γ * k⁻¹ * k := by rw [← hγ]
      _ = k * ρ γ := by group
  · intro hk
    exact holLiftAut_mem (centralizerToEρ ρ ⟨k, hk⟩).2

name: holReind_one
statement:
theorem holReind_one {s t : SingleObj Γ} (γ : s ⟶ t) (y : HolTotal Γ G) :

proof:
:= by

:= by

  constructor
  · intro hg
    have h := hg (Equiv.swap 0 1) (MonoidHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨_, holS3ρ_ofAdd_one⟩)
    clear hg
    revert g

  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩ h hh
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := MonoidHom.mem_range.mp hh

  have h : Equiv.swap (1 : Fin 3) 2 ∈
      Subgroup.centralizer (holS3ρ.range : Set (Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))) := htop ▸ Subgroup.mem_top _
  have h2 := Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff.mp h (Equiv.swap 0 1)
    (MonoidHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨_, holS3ρ_ofAdd_one⟩)
  revert h2
  decide

name: holQ8_ker_conj
statement:
theorem holQ8_ker_conj :
    (MulAut.conj : QuaternionGroup 2 →* MulAut (QuaternionGroup 2)).ker = holQ8Quot.ker
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, MonoidHom.mem_ker, DFunLike.ext_iff]

name: holQ8_no_section
statement:
theorem holQ8_no_section :
    ¬ ∃ σ : Hρ (MonoidHom.id (QuaternionGroup 2)) →* Eρ (MonoidHom.id (QuaternionGroup 2)),
      (EρToHρ (MonoidHom.id (QuaternionGroup 2))).comp σ = MonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨σ, hσ⟩
  let i : QuaternionGroup 2 := QuaternionGroup.a 1
  let αi : Hρ (MonoidHom.id (QuaternionGroup 2)) := ⟨MulAut.conj i, i, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hsq : αi * αi = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    show MulAut.conj i * MulAut.conj i = 1
    rw [← map_mul]
    ext γ
    show (i * i) * γ * (i * i)⁻¹ = γ
    revert γ
    decide
  have hproj : (σ αi).1.2 = MulAut.conj i :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (DFunLike.congr_fun hσ αi)
  have hq : (σ αi).1.1 * (σ αi).1.1 = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun e : Eρ (MonoidHom.id (QuaternionGroup 2)) => e.1.1)
      (show σ αi * σ αi = 1 by rw [← map_mul, hsq, map_one])
    exact h
  have h1 := (σ αi).2 (QuaternionGroup.xa 0)
  rw [hproj] at h1
  simp only [MonoidHom.id_apply, MulAut.conj_apply] at h1
  generalize (σ αi).1.1 = q at hq h1
  revert q
  decide

name: holQ8_orderOf_lift
statement:
theorem holQ8_orderOf_lift (e : Eρ (MonoidHom.id (QuaternionGroup 2)))
    (he : EρToHρ (MonoidHom.id (QuaternionGroup 2)) e ≠ 1) : orderOf e = 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MulEquiv.orderOf_eq (holQ8EρEquiv) e]
  have hne : e.1.2 ≠ 1 := fun h => he (Subtype.ext h)
  rw [(mem_Eρ_id_iff _ _).mp e.2] at hne
  have hne' : ∃ γ, e.1.1 * γ * e.1.1⁻¹ ≠ γ := by
    by_contra hcon
    exact hne (MulEquiv.ext fun γ => by
      by_contra h
      exact hcon ⟨γ, h⟩)
  show orderOf e.1.1 = 2 ^ (1 + 1)
  have : Fact (Nat.Prime 2) := ⟨Nat.prime_two⟩
  have key : ∀ q : QuaternionGroup 2, (∃ γ, q * γ * q⁻¹ ≠ γ) →
      ¬ q ^ 2 ^ 1 = 1 ∧ q ^ 2 ^ (1 + 1) = 1 := by
    decide
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := key e.1.1 hne'
  exact orderOf_eq_prime_pow h1 h2

      hg x (MonoidHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩)
    clear hg
    revert g
    decide
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩ x -
    revert a x
    decide

name: isNonfaithfulLift_of_functor
statement:
theorem isNonfaithfulLift_of_functor (F : SingleObj K ⥤ SingleObj K) : IsNonfaithfulLift K F where
  covers
proof:
:= CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  equiv _ _ := rfl
  equiv_map f _ := by
    show F.map f = eqToHom _ ≫ F.map f ≫ eqToHom _
    simp only [NonFaithful.eqToHom_eq_one, SingleObj.comp_as_mul, mul_one, one_mul]
  src _ _ _ := rfl
  map_chi _ y _ := by
    rw [NonFaithful.eqToHom_eq_one]
    exact (F.map_id y).trans (mul_one (1 : K)).symm
  map_ltrans _ x := by
    rw [NonFaithful.eqToHom_eq_one]
    exact (F.map_id x).trans (mul_one (1 : K)).symm

name: nonfaithful_preserves_base_coord
statement:
theorem nonfaithful_preserves_base_coord (F : SingleObj K ⥤ SingleObj K) :
    (∀ s : Discrete PUnit.{1},
        F.obj ((nonfaithfulPreDatum K).base s) = (nonfaithfulPreDatum K).base s) ∧
      ∀ x : SingleObj K, (nonfaithfulPreDatum K).coord (F.obj x) = (nonfaithfulPreDatum K).coord x

statement: theorem omega_ne_zero : omega ≠ 0

name: ComplexObstruction.omega_inv_ne
statement: theorem omega_inv_ne : omega⁻¹ ≠ omega
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h2 : omega ^ 2 = 1 := by
    calc
      omega ^ 2 = omega⁻¹ * omega := by rw [pow_two, h]
      _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ omega_ne_zero
  exact (omega_primitive.pow_ne_one_of_pos_of_lt (l := 2) (by decide) (by decide)) h2

name: ComplexObstruction.character_generator

proof:
:= by
  change (ZMod.lift 3 ⟨intCharacter, intCharacter_three⟩ (1 : ZMod 3)).toMul = omegaUnit
  have h := ZMod.lift_coe 3 ⟨intCharacter, intCharacter_three⟩ (1 : ℤ)
  simpa [intCharacter] using congrArg Additive.toMul h

name: ComplexObstruction.intertwiner_eq_zero
statement:
theorem intertwiner_eq_zero (f : ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (h : ∀ z : ℂ, f (omega⁻¹ * z) = omega * f z) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  have hf : omega⁻¹ * f z = omega * f z := by
    simpa only [← smul_eq_mul, map_smul] using h z
  have hz : (omega⁻¹ - omega) * f z = 0 := by rw [sub_mul, hf, sub_self]
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr omega_inv_ne)

name: ComplexObstruction.no_invariant_complex_implementation
statement:
theorem no_invariant_complex_implementation :
    ¬ Nonempty (complexData.InvariantImplementation swapFunctor (twistθ twistHSwap))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ :=
    (complexData.invariant_implementation_iff swapFunctor (twistθ twistHSwap)).mp h
  let s : Pair (Fin 2) := ⟨0⟩
  let b : ℂ ≃ₗ[ℂ] ℂ := (β.app s).toLinearEquiv
  have hz : b.toLinearMap = 0 := by
    apply intertwiner_eq_zero
    intro z
    have he := congrArg
      (fun f : ModuleCat.of ℂ ℂ ⟶ ModuleCat.of ℂ ℂ => (f.hom z : ℂ)) (hβ s twistR)
    change b ((character (twistθ twistHSwap twistR) : ℂ) * z) =
      (character twistR : ℂ) * b z at he
    rw [twistθ_swap_apply, map_inv, character_generator, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val] at he
    exact he
  have h1 : b (1 : ℂ) = 0 := congrArg (fun f : ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ => f (1 : ℂ)) hz
  exact one_ne_zero (b.injective (h1.trans (map_zero b).symm))

name: ComplexObstruction.no_invariant_complex_implementation_any_lift
statement:
theorem no_invariant_complex_implementation_any_lift
    (T : Pair (Fin 2) × Pair G3 ⥤ Pair (Fin 2) × Pair G3)
    (hT : IsTwistedEquivariant twistData (twistθ twistHSwap) T)
    (hpc : PreservesCleavage twistData T swapFunctor) :
    ¬ ∃ (hTF : OEData.IsInvariant twistData (T ⋙ F)) (α : T ⋙ F ≅ F),
      IsInvariantNatTrans twistData hTF F_isInvariant α.hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, _⟩ := exists_unique_eq_liftFunctorθ_comp_Λ twistData hT hpc
  have hf : T ⋙ F = (complexData.twisted swapFunctor (twistθ twistHSwap)).presentationFunctor := by
    rw [ha]
    exact complexData.translated_lift_comp_presentationFunctor swapFunctor (twistθ twistHSwap) a
  rintro ⟨hTF, α, hα⟩
  let α' := (eqToIso hf).symm ≪≫ α
  apply no_invariant_complex_implementation
  refine ⟨⟨α', (ResidualData.invariant_iff_constant α'.hom).mpr ?_⟩⟩
  intro s a
  have hc (x : Pair (Fin 2) × Pair G3) : α'.hom.app x = α.hom.app x := by
    change (eqToHom hf.symm).app x ≫ α.hom.app x = α.hom.app x
    rw [eqToHom_app]
    exact Category.id_comp _
  rw [hc, hc]
  have h := hα a (s, ⟨1⟩)
  dsimp only [productData_act] at h
  rw [one_mul] at h
  exact h.trans (cast_self _ _ _)

name: ComplexObstruction.unrestrictedImplementation_app
statement:
theorem unrestrictedImplementation_app (s : Pair (Fin 2)) (g : G3) (z : ℂ) :
    (unrestrictedImplementation.hom.app (s, ⟨g⟩)).hom z = (character g : ℂ) ^ 2 * z
proof:
:= by
  change (character g : ℂ) *
    ((((character (twistθ twistHSwap g))⁻¹ : ℂˣ) : ℂ) * z) = _
  simp [twistθ_swap_apply, map_inv, pow_two, mul_assoc]

name: ComplexObstruction.unrestrictedImplementation_not_invariant
statement:

    ¬ IsInvariantNatTrans twistData
      (complexData.twisted swapFunctor (twistθ twistHSwap)).presentationFunctor_isInvariant
      complexData.presentationFunctor_isInvariant unrestrictedImplementation.hom
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact no_invariant_complex_implementation ⟨⟨unrestrictedImplementation, h⟩⟩

name: ComplexObstruction.omega_conj
statement: theorem omega_conj : starRingEnd ℂ omega = omega⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [omega, ← Complex.exp_conj, ← Complex.exp_neg]
  congr 1
  simp only [map_div₀, map_mul, map_ofNat, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_I]
  ring

name: ComplexObstruction.character_conj
statement:
theorem character_conj (g : G3) :
    starRingEnd ℂ (character g : ℂ) = (character g : ℂ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have cases3 : ∀ g : G3, g = 1 ∨ g = twistR ∨ g = twistR ^ 2 := by decide
  rcases cases3 g with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · simp
  · rw [character_generator]
    exact omega_conj
  · simp [map_pow, character_generator, omegaUnit, omega_conj, inv_pow]

name: ComplexObstruction.realData_presentationFunctor
statement: theorem realData_presentationFunctor : realData.presentationFunctor = F ⋙ realification
proof:
:= by
  refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => rfl) (fun X Y f => ?_)
  change realification.map (complexData.σ X.1 (Y.2.pt * X.2.pt⁻¹)).hom ≫
    realification.map (complexData.E.map f.1) =
      𝟙 _ ≫ realification.map
        ((complexData.σ X.1 (Y.2.pt * X.2.pt⁻¹)).hom ≫ complexData.E.map f.1) ≫ 𝟙 _
  rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  exact (realification.map_comp _ _).symm

name: ComplexObstruction.real_intertwines
statement:
theorem real_intertwines (s : Pair (Fin 2)) (g : G3) :
    (realData.σ (swapFunctor.obj s) (twistθ twistHSwap g)).hom ≫ realBaseIso.hom.app s =
      realBaseIso.hom.app s ≫ (realData.σ s g).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  change ℂ at z
  change starRingEnd ℂ ((character (twistθ twistHSwap g) : ℂ) * z) =
    (character g : ℂ) * starRingEnd ℂ z
  rw [twistθ_swap_apply, map_inv, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, map_mul, map_inv₀,
    character_conj, inv_inv]

name: ComplexObstruction.realImplementation_app
statement:
theorem realImplementation_app (s : Pair (Fin 2)) (a : G3) (z : ℂ) :
    (realImplementation.val.hom.app (s, ⟨a⟩)).hom z = starRingEnd ℂ z
proof:
:= by
  have h := realData.implementation_app swapFunctor (twistθ twistHSwap) realImplementation s a
  have hc : realImplementation.val.hom.app (s, ⟨a⟩) = realBaseIso.hom.app s := by
    simpa only [realImplementation, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using h
  rw [hc]
  rfl

name: recScalar_apply
statement:
theorem recScalar_apply (τ : ℝ) (I : RecDom) (c : ℝ) (y : recordSpace τ I) (j : ↥I.dom) :

name: recScalar_ne
statement:
theorem recScalar_ne (τ : ℝ) (I : RecDom) {c c' : ℝ} (hc : c ≠ c') :
    recScalar τ I c ≠ recScalar τ I c'
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := I.nonempty
  have h := congrArg (fun k : (L₀ τ).obj I ⟶ (L₀ τ).obj I =>
    Subtype.val (k.hom (recordOne τ I)) ⟨j, hj⟩) e
  change c * 1 = c' * 1 at h
  rw [mul_one, mul_one] at h
  exact hc h

name: recD_map_apply
statement:
theorem recD_map_apply (τ : ℝ) {X Y : RecDom × Pair ℤˣ} (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : recordSpace τ X.1)
    (j : ↥Y.1.dom) :
    Subtype.val (((recD τ).map f).hom y) j
      = (((Y.2.pt * X.2.pt⁻¹ : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) * Subtype.val y ⟨j.1, RecDom.subset_of_hom f.1 j.2⟩

proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext j
  change c' * (c * Subtype.val y j) = (c' * c) * Subtype.val y j
  rw [mul_assoc]

name: recD_map_vert
statement:
theorem recD_map_vert (τ : ℝ) (X : RecDom × Pair ℤˣ) (h : ℤˣ) :

proof:

  apply Subtype.ext

      = recScalar τ X.1 (((h⁻¹ : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) ≫ (recC τ).hom.app X
proof:
:= by
  change recScalar τ X.1 ((((X.2.pt * h)⁻¹ : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ)
    = recScalar τ X.1 (((h⁻¹ : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) ≫ recScalar τ X.1 (((X.2.pt⁻¹ : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ)
  rw [recScalar_comp, ← recSign_mul, mul_inv_rev, mul_comm h⁻¹]

name: recC_hom_app_act_eq_neg
statement:
theorem recC_hom_app_act_eq_neg (τ : ℝ) (X : RecDom × Pair ℤˣ) :
    (recC τ).hom.app (recData.act X (-1)) = -(recC τ).hom.app X
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext j
  change ((((X.2.pt * (-1))⁻¹ : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) * Subtype.val y j
    = -((((X.2.pt⁻¹ : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) * Subtype.val y j)
  rw [mul_inv_rev, recSign_mul, recSign_inv (-1), recSign_neg_one]
  ring

name: recC_not_invariant
statement:
theorem recC_not_invariant (τ : ℝ) :
    ¬ IsInvariantNatTrans recData (recD_isInvariant τ) (isInvariant_comp_p recData (L₀ τ))
      (recC τ).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro hC
  have e : (recC τ).hom.app (recData.act (RecDom.full, ⟨1⟩) (-1))
      = (recC τ).hom.app (RecDom.full, ⟨1⟩) :=
    (hC (-1) (RecDom.full, ⟨1⟩)).trans (eqToHom_comp_comp_eqToHom_self _ _ _)
  rw [recC_hom_app_act_neg_one] at e
  change recScalar τ RecDom.full (-1) ≫ recScalar τ RecDom.full ((((1 : ℤˣ)⁻¹ : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ)
    = recScalar τ RecDom.full ((((1 : ℤˣ)⁻¹ : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) at e
  rw [recScalar_comp] at e
  have hne : (((((1 : ℤˣ)⁻¹ : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) * (-1)) ≠ ((((1 : ℤˣ)⁻¹ : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [recSign_inv, recSign_one]
    norm_num
  exact recScalar_ne τ RecDom.full hne e

name: recD_invariantNatTrans_vertical
statement:
theorem recD_invariantNatTrans_vertical (τ : ℝ) (T : recD τ ⟶ recP ⋙ L₀ τ)
    (hT : IsInvariantNatTrans recData (recD_isInvariant τ) (isInvariant_comp_p recData (L₀ τ)) T)
    (X : RecDom × Pair ℤˣ) (h : ℤˣ) :
    recScalar τ X.1 (((h : ℤ) : ℝ)) ≫ T.app X = T.app X
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  have e := congrArg
    (fun k : (recD τ).obj X ⟶ (recP ⋙ L₀ τ).obj (recData.act X h) => k.hom y)
    (T.naturality (recVert X h))
  have hinv : T.app (recData.act X h) = T.app X :=
    (hT h X).trans (eqToHom_comp_comp_eqToHom_self _ _ _)
  have e2 := congrArg
    (fun k : (recD τ).obj (recData.act X h) ⟶ (recP ⋙ L₀ τ).obj (recData.act X h) =>
      k.hom (((recD τ).map (recVert X h)).hom y)) hinv
  rw [recD_map_vert] at e e2
  change (T.app X).hom ((recScalar τ X.1 (((h : ℤ) : ℝ))).hom y) = (T.app X).hom y
  exact e2.symm.trans e

name: recD_invariantNatTrans_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem recD_invariantNatTrans_apply_eq_zero (τ : ℝ) (T : recD τ ⟶ recP ⋙ L₀ τ)
    (hT : IsInvariantNatTrans recData (recD_isInvariant τ) (isInvariant_comp_p recData (L₀ τ)) T)
    (X : RecDom × Pair ℤˣ) (y : (L₀ τ).obj X.1) : (T.app X).hom y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e := congrArg (fun k : (L₀ τ).obj X.1 ⟶ (L₀ τ).obj X.1 => k.hom y)
    (recD_invariantNatTrans_vertical τ T hT X (-1))
  have hlin : (T.app X).hom ((recScalar τ X.1 (((-1 : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ)).hom y)
      = (((-1 : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) • (T.app X).hom y :=
    map_smul (T.app X).hom (((-1 : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) y
  have e2 : (((-1 : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) • (T.app X).hom y = (T.app X).hom y := hlin.symm.trans e
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext j
  have ej := congrArg (fun w : recordSpace τ X.1 => Subtype.val w j) e2
  change (((-1 : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) * Subtype.val ((T.app X).hom y) j
    = Subtype.val ((T.app X).hom y) j at ej
  rw [recSign_neg_one] at ej
  change Subtype.val ((T.app X).hom y) j = 0
  linarith

name: recD_invariantNatTrans_app_eq_zero
statement:
theorem recD_invariantNatTrans_app_eq_zero (τ : ℝ) (T : recD τ ⟶ recP ⋙ L₀ τ)
    (hT : IsInvariantNatTrans recData (recD_isInvariant τ) (isInvariant_comp_p recData (L₀ τ)) T)
    (X : RecDom × Pair ℤˣ) : T.app X = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  exact recD_invariantNatTrans_apply_eq_zero τ T hT X y

name: recD_invariantNatTrans_eq_zero
statement:
theorem recD_invariantNatTrans_eq_zero (τ : ℝ) (T : recD τ ⟶ recP ⋙ L₀ τ)
    (hT : IsInvariantNatTrans recData (recD_isInvariant τ) (isInvariant_comp_p recData (L₀ τ))
      T) : T = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext X
  rw [NatTrans.app_zero]
  exact recD_invariantNatTrans_app_eq_zero τ T hT X

name: recD_no_invariant_iso
statement:
theorem recD_no_invariant_iso (τ : ℝ) :
    ¬ ∃ α : recD τ ≅ recP ⋙ L₀ τ,
      IsInvariantNatTrans recData (recD_isInvariant τ) (isInvariant_comp_p recData (L₀ τ))
        α.hom
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨α, hα⟩
  have h0 := recD_invariantNatTrans_apply_eq_zero τ α.hom hα (RecDom.full, ⟨1⟩)
    (recordOne τ RecDom.full)
  have h1 : (α.inv.app (RecDom.full, ⟨1⟩)).hom
      ((α.hom.app (RecDom.full, ⟨1⟩)).hom (recordOne τ RecDom.full))
      = recordOne τ RecDom.full := by
    have := congrArg (fun k : (recD τ).obj (RecDom.full, ⟨1⟩) ⟶ (recD τ).obj (RecDom.full, ⟨1⟩) =>
      k.hom (recordOne τ RecDom.full)) (α.hom_inv_id_app (RecDom.full, ⟨1⟩))
    exact this
  rw [h0, map_zero] at h1
  exact recordOne_ne_zero τ RecDom.full h1.symm

name: recD_no_invariant_calibration
statement:
theorem recD_no_invariant_calibration (τ : ℝ) :
    ¬ ∃ (L : CategoryTheory.Functor.{0, 0} RecDom (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ)) (α : recD τ ≅ recP ⋙ L),
      IsInvariantNatTrans recData (recD_isInvariant τ) (isInvariant_comp_p recData L) α.hom
proof:
:=
  fun h => recD_residualAction_ne_one τ RecDom.full
    ((calibration_i_iff_iii recData (recD τ) (recD_isInvariant τ)).mp h RecDom.full)

name: recD_forget_isInvariant
statement:
theorem recD_forget_isInvariant (τ : ℝ) :
    OEData.IsInvariant recData (recD τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ))
proof:
:= fun h => by
  rw [← Functor.assoc, recD_isInvariant τ h]

name: recInfo_common_component
statement:
theorem recInfo_common_component (τ : ℝ)
    (K : recD τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ) ⟶ recP ⋙ L₀ τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ))
    (hK : IsInvariantNatTrans recData (recD_forget_isInvariant τ)
      (isInvariant_comp_p recData (L₀ τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ))) K)
    (X : RecDom × Pair ℤˣ) (h : ℤˣ) : K.app (recData.act X h) = K.app X

name: recInfo_vertical
statement:
theorem recInfo_vertical (τ : ℝ)
    (K : recD τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ) ⟶ recP ⋙ L₀ τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ))
    (hK : IsInvariantNatTrans recData (recD_forget_isInvariant τ)
      (isInvariant_comp_p recData (L₀ τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ))) K)
    (X : RecDom × Pair ℤˣ) (h : ℤˣ) (y : (L₀ τ).obj X.1) :
    K.app X ((recScalar τ X.1 (((h : ℤ) : ℝ))).hom y) = K.app X y
proof:
:= by
  have nat : K.app (recData.act X h) (((recD τ).map (recVert X h)).hom y) = K.app X y := by
    have e := types_congr_hom (K.naturality (recVert X h)) y
    rw [types_comp_apply, types_comp_apply] at e
    exact e
  rw [recInfo_common_component τ K hK X h, recD_map_vert] at nat
  exact nat

name: recInfo_even
statement:
theorem recInfo_even (τ : ℝ)
    (K : recD τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ) ⟶ recP ⋙ L₀ τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ))
    (hK : IsInvariantNatTrans recData (recD_forget_isInvariant τ)
      (isInvariant_comp_p recData (L₀ τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ))) K)
    (X : RecDom × Pair ℤˣ) (y : (L₀ τ).obj X.1) : K.app X (-y) = K.app X y
proof:
:= by
  have e := recInfo_vertical τ K hK X (-1) y
  have hy : (recScalar τ X.1 (((-1 : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ)).hom y = -y := by
    change (((-1 : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) • y = -y
    rw [recSign_neg_one, neg_one_smul]
  rw [hy] at e
  exact e

name: recInfo_vertical_naturality_iff_even
statement:
theorem recInfo_vertical_naturality_iff_even (τ : ℝ) (X : RecDom × Pair ℤˣ)
    (k : (recD τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ)).obj X
      ⟶ (recP ⋙ L₀ τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ)).obj X) :
    (recD τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ)).map (recVert X (-1)) ≫ k
        = k ≫ (recP ⋙ L₀ τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ)).map (recVert X (-1))
      ↔ ∀ y : (L₀ τ).obj X.1, k (-y) = k y
proof:
:= by
  have hD : ∀ y : (L₀ τ).obj X.1,
      ((recD τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ)).map (recVert X (-1)) ≫ k) y = k (-y) := by
    intro y
    have hy : ((recD τ).map (recVert X (-1))).hom y = -y := by
      rw [recD_map_vert]
      change (((-1 : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) • y = -y
      rw [recSign_neg_one, neg_one_smul]
    exact (types_comp_apply _ _ _).trans (TypeCat.congr_arg k hy)
  have hL : ∀ y : (L₀ τ).obj X.1,
      (k ≫ (recP ⋙ L₀ τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ)).map (recVert X (-1))) y = k y :=
    fun y => rfl
  constructor
  · intro hsq y
    exact (hD y).symm.trans ((types_congr_hom hsq y).trans (hL y))
  · intro hev
    exact ConcreteCategory.hom_ext _ _ fun y => (hD y).trans ((hev y).trans (hL y).symm)

name: recInfo_invariant_ne_id
statement:
theorem recInfo_invariant_ne_id (τ : ℝ)
    (K : recD τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ) ⟶ recP ⋙ L₀ τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ))
    (hK : IsInvariantNatTrans recData (recD_forget_isInvariant τ)
      (isInvariant_comp_p recData (L₀ τ ⋙ forget (ModuleCat.{0} ℝ))) K)
    (X : RecDom × Pair ℤˣ) : ¬ ∀ y : (L₀ τ).obj X.1, K.app X y = y
proof:
:= by
  intro hid
  have e := recInfo_even τ K hK X (recordOne τ X.1)
  rw [hid, hid] at e
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := X.1.nonempty
  have ej := congrArg (fun w : recordSpace τ X.1 => Subtype.val w ⟨j, hj⟩) e
  change -(1 : ℝ) = 1 at ej
  norm_num at ej

name: recInfo_no_recovery_at
statement:
theorem recInfo_no_recovery_at (τ : ℝ) (I : RecDom) :
    ¬ ∃ k : (L₀ τ).obj I → (L₀ τ).obj I,
      ∀ (q : (L₀ τ).obj I) (ε : ℤˣ), k ((((ε : ℤ) : ℝ)) • q) = q
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
  have h1 := hk (-(recordOne τ I : (L₀ τ).obj I)) 1
  have h2 := hk (recordOne τ I) (-1)
  rw [recSign_one, one_smul] at h1
  rw [recSign_neg_one, neg_one_smul] at h2
  have e := h1.symm.trans h2
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := I.nonempty
  have ej := congrArg (fun w : recordSpace τ I => Subtype.val w ⟨j, hj⟩) e
  change -(1 : ℝ) = 1 at ej
  norm_num at ej

name: recInfo_no_recovery
statement:
theorem recInfo_no_recovery (τ : ℝ) :
    ¬ ∃ K : ∀ I : RecDom, (L₀ τ).obj I → (L₀ τ).obj I,
      ∀ (I : RecDom) (q : (L₀ τ).obj I) (ε : ℤˣ), K I ((((ε : ℤ) : ℝ)) • q) = q
proof:
:=
  fun ⟨K, hK⟩ => recInfo_no_recovery_at τ RecDom.full ⟨K RecDom.full, hK RecDom.full⟩

name: RecDom.subset_of_hom
statement: theorem subset_of_hom {I J : RecDom} (u : I ⟶ J) : J.dom ⊆ I.dom

name: RecDom.not_isIso_fromFull_single
statement: theorem RecDom.not_isIso_fromFull_single : ¬ IsIso (RecDom.fromFull (RecDom.single 0))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hsub := RecDom.subset_of_hom (inv (RecDom.fromFull (RecDom.single 0)))
  have h1 : (1 : Fin 3) ∈ (RecDom.single 0).dom := hsub (Finset.mem_univ _)
  exact absurd h1 (by decide)

name: mem_recordSpace
statement:
theorem mem_recordSpace {τ : ℝ} {I : RecDom} {x : ↥I.dom → ℝ} :
    x ∈ recordSpace τ I ↔ ∃ q₀ v : ℝ, ∀ j : ↥I.dom, x j = q₀ + v * (((j : Fin 3) : ℕ) : ℝ) * τ

name: mem_recordSpace_full_iff
statement:
theorem mem_recordSpace_full_iff {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (x : ↥RecDom.full.dom → ℝ) :
    x ∈ recordSpace τ RecDom.full ↔
      x ⟨2, Finset.mem_univ _⟩ - 2 * x ⟨1, Finset.mem_univ _⟩ + x ⟨0, Finset.mem_univ _⟩ = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q₀, v, hx⟩
    rw [hx, hx, hx]
    simp
    ring
  · intro h
    refine ⟨x ⟨0, Finset.mem_univ _⟩, (x ⟨1, Finset.mem_univ _⟩ - x ⟨0, Finset.mem_univ _⟩) / τ,
      ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
    have hτ' : τ ≠ 0 := hτ.ne'
    fin_cases j
    · simp
    · simp
      field_simp
      ring
    · simp
      field_simp
      linarith

name: recordOne_ne_zero
statement: theorem recordOne_ne_zero (τ : ℝ) (I : RecDom) : recordOne τ I ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := I.nonempty
  have := congrArg (fun x : recordSpace τ I => (x : ↥I.dom → ℝ) ⟨j, hj⟩) h
  simp [recordOne] at this

name: recRestrict_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem recRestrict_apply (τ : ℝ) {I J : RecDom} (h : J.dom ⊆ I.dom)
    (x : recordSpace τ I) (j : ↥J.dom) :
    (recRestrict τ h x : ↥J.dom → ℝ) j = (x : ↥I.dom → ℝ) ⟨j.1, h j.2⟩

name: recRestrict_smul
statement:
theorem recRestrict_smul (τ : ℝ) {I J : RecDom} (h : J.dom ⊆ I.dom) (c : ℝ)
    (x : recordSpace τ I) : recRestrict τ h (c • x) = c • recRestrict τ h x

name: L₀_obj

name: L₀_map
statement:
theorem L₀_map (τ : ℝ) {I J : RecDom} (u : I ⟶ J) :
    (L₀ τ).map u = ModuleCat.ofHom (recRestrict τ (RecDom.subset_of_hom u))

name: L₀_map_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem L₀_map_hom_apply (τ : ℝ) {I J : RecDom} (u : I ⟶ J) (x : recordSpace τ I)
    (j : ↥J.dom) :
    Subtype.val (((L₀ τ).map u).hom x) j
      = (x : ↥I.dom → ℝ) ⟨j.1, RecDom.subset_of_hom u j.2⟩

name: L₀_exists_ne_zero
statement: theorem L₀_exists_ne_zero (τ : ℝ) (I : RecDom) : ∃ x : (L₀ τ).obj I, x ≠ 0

name: Lℓ_comp_snd

    recData.reind u (J, ⟨δ⟩) rfl = (I, ⟨δ⟩)

name: recSign_mul
statement:
theorem recSign_mul (ε δ : ℤˣ) :
    (((ε * δ : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) = ((ε : ℤ) : ℝ) * ((δ : ℤ) : ℝ)

name: recSign_mul_self
statement: theorem recSign_mul_self (ε : ℤˣ) : ((ε : ℤ) : ℝ) * ((ε : ℤ) : ℝ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or ε with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num

name: recSign_inv
statement: theorem recSign_inv (ε : ℤˣ) : (((ε⁻¹ : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) = ((ε : ℤ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or ε with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num

name: recSign_one
statement: theorem recSign_one : (((1 : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) = 1

name: recSign_neg_one
statement: theorem recSign_neg_one : (((-1 : ℤˣ) : ℤ) : ℝ) = -1

name: recSign_ne_zero
statement: theorem recSign_ne_zero (ε : ℤˣ) : ((ε : ℤ) : ℝ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or ε with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num

name: recρ_cast
statement: theorem recρ_cast (j : Fin 3) : (((recρ j : Fin 3) : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 - (((j : Fin 3) : ℕ) : ℝ)

statement: theorem recρ_recρ (j : Fin 3) : recρ (recρ j) = j

name: RecDom.mem_rev
statement: theorem RecDom.mem_rev {I : RecDom} {j : Fin 3} : j ∈ I.rev.dom ↔ recρ j ∈ I.dom

:= by

name: recAFunctor_comp_self
statement: theorem recAFunctor_comp_self : recAFunctor ⋙ recAFunctor = 𝟭 RecDom

name: RecDom.rev_single_zero
statement: theorem RecDom.rev_single_zero : (RecDom.single 0).rev = RecDom.single 2
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  rw [RecDom.mem_rev]
  fin_cases j <;> decide

name: recA_ne_one
statement: theorem recA_ne_one : recA ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h0 := congrArg (fun B : StrictAut RecDom => B.hom.obj (RecDom.single 0)) h
  simp only [recA_hom_obj, RecDom.rev_single_zero, StrictAut.one_hom, Functor.id_obj] at h0
  have h2 : (2 : Fin 3) ∈ (RecDom.single 2).dom := Finset.mem_singleton_self _
  rw [h0] at h2
  exact absurd h2 (by decide)

name: RecordsExample.c2Hom_one'
statement:
@[simp] theorem c2Hom_one' [DecidableEq A] (a : A) (hA : ∀ x : A, x = 1 ∨ x = a) (ha : a ≠ 1)
    (haa : a * a = 1) (b : B) (hbb : b * b = 1) : c2Hom a hA ha haa b hbb 1 = 1

    (hA : ∀ x : A, x = 1 ∨ x = a) (ha : a ≠ 1) (haa : a * a = 1) (b : B)
    (hB : ∀ y : B, y = 1 ∨ y = b) (hb : b ≠ 1) (hbb : b * b = 1) :
    c2MulEquiv a hA ha haa b hB hb hbb a = b

name: mem_recH
statement: theorem mem_recH {B : StrictAut RecDom} : B ∈ recH ↔ B = 1 ∨ B = recA
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hB
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.1 hB
    obtain ⟨m, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.even_or_odd' k
    · left
      rw [zpow_mul, zpow_two, recA_mul_self, one_zpow]
    · right
      rw [zpow_add_one, zpow_mul, zpow_two, recA_mul_self, one_zpow, one_mul]
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact one_mem _
    · exact Subgroup.mem_zpowers _

name: recH_cases
statement: theorem recH_cases (B : recH) : B = 1 ∨ B = recHA
proof:
:= by
  rcases mem_recH.1 B.2 with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext h)
  · exact Or.inr (Subtype.ext h)

name: recHA_ne_one
statement: theorem recHA_ne_one : recHA ≠ 1

name: recHA_mul_self
statement: theorem recHA_mul_self : recHA * recHA = 1

name: recH_card
statement: theorem recH_card : Nat.card recH = 2

name: recLift_obj
statement:
theorem recLift_obj (I : RecDom) (ε : ℤˣ) :
    (liftHomOver recData recH recHA).1.hom.obj (I, ⟨ε⟩) = (I.rev, ⟨ε⟩)
proof:
:= by
  show ((I.rev, ⟨1 * ε⟩) : RecDom × Pair ℤˣ) = (I.rev, ⟨ε⟩)
  rw [one_mul]

name: recPolarity_obj
statement:
theorem recPolarity_obj (h : ℤˣ) (I : RecDom) (ε : ℤˣ) :
    (ΛHomOver recData recH h).1.hom.obj (I, ⟨ε⟩) = (I, ⟨h * ε⟩)
proof:
:= by
  show ((I, ⟨1 * (h * ε)⟩) : RecDom × Pair ℤˣ) = (I, ⟨h * ε⟩)

name: recA_comp_Lℓ_ne
statement: theorem recA_comp_Lℓ_ne (τ : ℝ) : recA.hom ⋙ Lℓ τ ≠ Lℓ τ
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h0 := congrArg (fun F : RecDom ⥤ Pair RecDom × ModuleCat.{0} ℝ =>
    ((F.obj (RecDom.single 0)).1.pt).dom) h
  change (RecDom.single 0).rev.dom = (RecDom.single 0).dom at h0
  rw [RecDom.rev_single_zero] at h0
  have h2 : (2 : Fin 3) ∈ (RecDom.single 2).dom := Finset.mem_singleton_self _
  rw [h0] at h2
  exact absurd h2 (by decide)

name: strictLawStabilizer_Lℓ_eq_bot

  ext B
  simp only [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  constructor
  · intro hB
    have hB' : B.hom ⋙ Lℓ τ = Lℓ τ := hB
    have hobj : ∀ I, B.hom.obj I = I := fun I => by
      have := congrArg (fun F : RecDom ⥤ Pair RecDom × ModuleCat.{0} ℝ => (F.obj I).1.pt) hB'
      exact this
    exact StrictAut.ext_hom (CategoryTheory.Functor.ext hobj (fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _))

name: L₀_eqToHom_hom_apply_of_eq

theorem L₀_eqToHom_hom_apply_of_eq (τ : ℝ) {I I' : RecDom} (hI : I = I')
    (e : (L₀ τ).obj I = (L₀ τ).obj I') (x : recordSpace τ I) (j : ↥I'.dom) :
    Subtype.val ((eqToHom e).hom x) j = (x : ↥I.dom → ℝ) ⟨j.1, by subst hI; exact j.2⟩

name: recA_comp_L₀_ne
statement: theorem recA_comp_L₀_ne (τ : ℝ) (hτ : τ ≠ 0) : recA.hom ⋙ L₀ τ ≠ L₀ τ
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have key := Functor.congr_hom h (RecDom.fromFull (RecDom.single 0))
  have hf : recA.hom.obj RecDom.full = RecDom.full := by
    ext j; simp [recA_hom_obj, RecDom.rev, RecDom.full]
  have h2mem : (2 : Fin 3) ∈ (recA.hom.obj (RecDom.single 0)).dom := by
    rw [recA_hom_obj, RecDom.mem_rev]; decide
  have e := congrArg (fun k : (recA.hom ⋙ L₀ τ).obj RecDom.full ⟶
      (recA.hom ⋙ L₀ τ).obj (RecDom.single 0) =>
    Subtype.val (k.hom (recIdxRecord τ hτ _)) ⟨2, h2mem⟩) key
  simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply] at e
  have hz : ((L₀ τ).map (RecDom.fromFull (RecDom.single 0))).hom
      ((eqToHom (Functor.congr_obj h RecDom.full)).hom (recIdxRecord τ hτ _)) = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext; funext j
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := j
    have : j = 0 := Finset.mem_singleton.1 hj
    subst this
    rw [L₀_map_hom_apply]
    have := L₀_eqToHom_hom_apply_of_eq τ hf (Functor.congr_obj h RecDom.full)
      (recIdxRecord τ hτ _) ⟨0, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
    erw [this]
    simp [recIdxRecord]; rfl
  rw [hz, map_zero] at e
  change (2 : ℝ) = 0 at e
  norm_num at e

  intro x

name: TwoObjectExample.strictAut_eq_one
statement: theorem strictAut_eq_one (A : StrictAut (Fin 2)) : A = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : ∀ x : Fin 2, A.inv.obj (A.hom.obj x) = x := fun x =>
    Functor.congr_obj A.hom_inv_id x
  have hle : A.hom.obj 0 ≤ A.hom.obj 1 := leOfHom (A.hom.map arrow01)
  have hne : A.hom.obj 0 ≠ A.hom.obj 1 := fun h => by
    have := congrArg A.inv.obj h
    rw [hinj, hinj] at this
    exact absurd this (by decide)
  have key : ∀ a b : Fin 2, a ≤ b → a ≠ b → a = 0 ∧ b = 1 := by decide
  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := key _ _ hle hne
  have hobj : ∀ x : Fin 2, A.hom.obj x = x := fun x => by
    fin_cases x
    · exact h0
    · exact h1
  have hhom : A.hom = 𝟭 (Fin 2) :=
    CategoryTheory.Functor.ext hobj (fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  have hinv : A.inv = 𝟭 (Fin 2) := by
    have h := A.hom_inv_id
    rw [hhom] at h
    exact h
  cases A
  simp only at hhom hinv
  subst hhom hinv
  rfl

name: TwoObjectExample.transportKerToProd_injective
statement: theorem transportKerToProd_injective : Function.Injective transportKerToProd
proof:
:= by
  intro e₁ e₂ h
  have h' : transportKerToKer e₁ = transportKerToKer e₂ := (kerEquivProd).injective h
  have h'' : autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver twoObjData ⊤ e₁.1
      = autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver twoObjData ⊤ e₂.1 := congrArg Subtype.val h'
  exact Subtype.ext (autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver_injective twoObjData ⊤ h'')

name: TwoObjectExample.transportKerToProd_range
statement: theorem transportKerToProd_range : transportKerToProd.range = diagSubgroup C2
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_range, mem_diagSubgroup]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, rfl⟩
    have pc : PreservesCleavage twoObjData (autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver twoObjData ⊤ e.1).hom
        (autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver twoObjData ⊤ e.1).base.1.hom :=
      (mem_range_autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver_iff twoObjData ⊤ _).1 ⟨e.1, rfl⟩
    exact (autEquivOver_preservesCleavage_iff twoObjData ⊤ _).1 pc arrow01
  · intro hx
    set k := (kerEquivProd).symm x with hk_def
    have hk : finTwoFunMulEquiv C2 (kerΦEquivOverMulEquiv twoObjData ⊤ k) = x :=
      (kerEquivProd).apply_symm_apply x
    have hconst : ∀ s : Fin 2, kerΦEquivOverMulEquiv twoObjData ⊤ k s = x.1 :=
      Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨congrArg Prod.fst hk, (congrArg Prod.snd hk).trans hx.symm⟩
    have pc : PreservesCleavage twoObjData k.1.hom k.1.base.1.hom :=
      (autEquivOver_preservesCleavage_iff twoObjData ⊤ k.1).2 fun {s t} _ =>
        (hconst s).trans (hconst t).symm
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := (mem_range_autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver_iff twoObjData ⊤ k.1).2 pc
    have hmem : e ∈ (ΦOver twoObjData ⊤).ker := by
      rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker]
      show ΦEquivOver twoObjData ⊤ (autBoxGOverToAutEquivOver twoObjData ⊤ e) = 1
      rw [he]
      exact MonoidHom.mem_ker.1 k.2
    refine ⟨⟨e, hmem⟩, ?_⟩
    have hkk : transportKerToKer ⟨e, hmem⟩ = k := Subtype.ext he
    show kerEquivProd (transportKerToKer ⟨e, hmem⟩) = x
    rw [hkk, hk_def, MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: TwoObjectExample.flipOne_not_preservesCleavage
statement:
theorem flipOne_not_preservesCleavage :
    ¬ PreservesCleavage twoObjData
      ((kerEquivProd).symm (1, Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod 2))).1.hom
      ((kerEquivProd).symm (1, Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod 2))).1.base.1.hom
proof:
:= by
  intro pc
  set k := (kerEquivProd).symm (1, Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod 2)) with hk_def
  have h : kerΦEquivOverMulEquiv twoObjData ⊤ k 0 = kerΦEquivOverMulEquiv twoObjData ⊤ k 1 :=
    (autEquivOver_preservesCleavage_iff twoObjData ⊤ k.1).1 pc arrow01
  have hk : finTwoFunMulEquiv C2 (kerΦEquivOverMulEquiv twoObjData ⊤ k)
      = (1, Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod 2)) :=
    (kerEquivProd).apply_symm_apply _
  have h0 : kerΦEquivOverMulEquiv twoObjData ⊤ k 0 = 1 := congrArg Prod.fst hk
  have h1 : kerΦEquivOverMulEquiv twoObjData ⊤ k 1 = Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod 2) :=
    congrArg Prod.snd hk
  have hne : (1 : C2) ≠ Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod 2) := by decide
  exact hne (h0.symm.trans (h.trans h1))

name: RecordsRecovery.maxProcedure_not_natural
statement:
theorem maxProcedure_not_natural (τ : ℝ) (hτ : τ ≠ 0) :
    ¬ RespectsRestrictions (maxProcedure τ)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  let y := recIdxRecord τ hτ RecDom.full
  let u := RecDom.fromFull (RecDom.single 0)
  have hfull : maxMagnitude τ RecDom.full y = 2 := by
    have hfin : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)) = {0, 1, 2} := by decide
    norm_num [maxMagnitude, y, recIdxRecord, RecDom.full, hfin,
      Finset.sup'_insert, Finset.sup'_singleton]
  have hzero : maxMagnitude τ (RecDom.single 0)
      (recRestrict τ (RecDom.subset_of_hom u) y) = 0 := by
    simp [maxMagnitude, RecDom.single, y, recIdxRecord, recRestrict]
    change ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 0
    exact Nat.cast_zero
  have he := h u y
  have he' := congrArg
    (fun z : recordSpace τ (RecDom.single 0) => z.val ⟨0, by simp [RecDom.single]⟩) he
  change maxMagnitude τ (RecDom.single 0) (recRestrict τ (RecDom.subset_of_hom u) y) * 1 =
    maxMagnitude τ RecDom.full y * 1 at he'
  rw [hzero, hfull] at he'
  norm_num at he'

name: RecordsRecovery.recα_trajectory
statement:
theorem recα_trajectory (τ : ℝ) (I : RecDom) (q v : ℝ) :
    ((recα τ).hom.app I).hom (trajectoryRecord τ I.rev q v) =
      trajectoryRecord τ I (q + 2 * τ * v) (-v)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext j
  rw [recα_hom_app_apply]
  change q + v * (((recρ j : Fin 3) : ℕ) : ℝ) * τ =
    q + 2 * τ * v + -v * (((j : Fin 3) : ℕ) : ℝ) * τ
  rw [recρ_cast]
  ring
